"messages" : [ {
"role" : "system",
"content" : "Your task is to generate a complete and diverse instance, in plain English, for a given category and based on a provided conceptual model description. The instance must adhere to these requirements:\n- Be self-contained: Include all required attributes, relationships, and related entities in full detail.\n- Conform to the model: Fulfill the constraints, multiplicities, relationships, and attributes defined in the class diagram model.\n- Understand the context: Ensure that its attributes and relationships are relevant.\n- Avoid duplication of instances: Take into consideration those instances previously built to avoid redundancy.\n- Semantic diversity: From a semantic point of view, incorporate varied scenarios, including regional, linguistic, or cultural differences.\n- Structural diversity: Include instances with different numbers of elements, different numbers of relationships and complexity, and create varied examples by changing entity attributes.\n"
}, {
"role" : "user",
"content" : "# Conceptual model description:\n## Description\nThis model describes a restaurant domain with people (owners, customers, workers), reservations (individual and banquet), tables, ordering, and menu composition (menu items built from food items with allergens). It also includes staff structure (head waiter/waiters, cooks/chefs) and a few business rules as invariants.\n\n### Components\n\n#### Data types\n- **Date**\n  - Operation: `Date(date : String)` (constructs a Date from a String)\n- **Time**\n  - Operation: `Time(time : String)` (constructs a Time from a String)\n\n#### Enumerations\n- **SeatingPreference**: `Inside`, `Patio`\n- **SmokingPreference**: `Smoking`, `NonSmoking`\n- **PaymentMethod**: `Cash`, `CreditCard`\n- **ItemType**: `Apetizer`, `Main`, `Dessert`, `Beverage`\n- **UnitOfMeasure**: `Ounce`, `Sheet`, `Pound`, `Gram`, `Dozen`\n- **AllergenType**: `Lactose`, `Seafood`, `Nuts`, `Gluten`\n- **Diet**: `Vegetarian`, `Vegan`, `Kosher`, `Halal`\n- **Language**: `English`, `Spanish`, `German`, `Italian`\n\n#### Classes (with attributes)\n\n- **Restaurant**\n  - `name : String`\n\n- **Reservation** *(abstract)*\n  - `time : Time`\n  - `date : Date`\n  - `numberPeople : Integer`\n  - `name : String`\n  - `phoneNumber : String`\n  - `number : Integer`\n\n- **Individual** *(extends Reservation)*\n  - `seating : SeatingPreference`\n  - `smoking : SmokingPreference`\n\n- **Banquet** *(extends Reservation)*\n  - `groupName : String`\n  - `paymentMethod : PaymentMethod`\n  - `busService : Boolean`\n\n- **Table**\n  - `number : Integer`\n  - `description : String`\n  - `capacity : Integer`\n\n- **ItemOrder**\n  - `time : Time`\n\n- **MenuItem**\n  - `description : String`\n  - `prepTime : Real`\n  - `classification : ItemType`\n\n- **FoodItem**\n  - `number : Integer`\n  - `description : String`\n  - `purchaseFlag : Boolean`\n  - `unit : UnitOfMeasure`\n\n- **Allergen**\n  - `type : AllergenType`\n\n- **Person**\n  - `name : String`\n\n- **Owner** *(extends Person)*\n  - `percentageShares : Integer`\n\n- **RegularCustomer** *(extends Person)*\n  - `prefferedLanguage : Language`\n\n- **DietaryRequirement**\n  - `diet : Diet`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **ReportedAllergy**\n  - `allergen : AllergenType`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **Worker** *(abstract, extends Person)*\n  - `dateOfBirth : Date`\n  - `phoneNumber : String`\n\n- **HeadWaiter** *(extends Worker)*\n- **Waiter** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `spokenLanguage : Language`\n- **Manager** *(extends Worker)*\n- **Cook** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `yearsOfExperience : Integer`\n- **Chef** *(extends Worker)*\n- **BusDriver** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `driverLicenseNr : String`\n\n---\n\n## Relationships\nFor each association, multiplicities are stated at both ends (how many instances at that end can be linked to one instance at the opposite end).\n\n1. **RestaurantOwner**: `Restaurant [1..*]` ↔ `Owner [1..*]`\n   - For **one Owner**: owns **1..*** Restaurants.\n   - For **one Restaurant**: has **1..*** Owners.\n\n2. **RestaurantReservation**: `Restaurant [0..1]` ↔ `Reservation [0..*]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: belongs to **0..1** Restaurant.\n   - For **one Restaurant**: has **0..*** Reservations.\n\n3. **ReservationCustomer**: `Reservation [0..*]` ↔ `RegularCustomer [0..1]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: linked to **0..1** RegularCustomer.\n   - For **one RegularCustomer**: linked to **0..*** Reservations.\n\n4. **ReservationWaiter**: `Reservation [*]` ↔ `Waiter [1..*]` (role on Waiter end: `servedBy`)\n   - For **one Reservation**: `servedBy` **1..*** Waiters.\n   - For **one Waiter**: serves **0..*** Reservations.\n\n5. **BanquetBusDriver**: `Banquet [1]` ↔ `BusDriver [0..*]`\n   - For **one Banquet**: has **0..*** BusDrivers.\n   - For **one BusDriver**: assigned to **exactly 1** Banquet.\n\n6. **ReservationTable**: `Reservation [1]` ↔ `Table [1..*]` (role on Table end: `assignedTo`)\n   - For **one Reservation**: `assignedTo` **1..*** Tables.\n   - For **one Table**: assigned to **exactly 1** Reservation.\n\n7. **ReservationItemOrdered**: `Reservation [1]` ↔ `ItemOrder [0..*]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: has **0..*** ItemOrders.\n   - For **one ItemOrder**: belongs to **exactly 1** Reservation.\n\n8. **ItemOrderMenuItem**: `ItemOrder [*]` ↔ `MenuItem [1]` (role on MenuItem end: `item`)\n   - For **one ItemOrder**: refers to **exactly 1** MenuItem (`item`).\n   - For **one MenuItem**: appears in **0..*** ItemOrders.\n\n9. **MenuItemFoodItem**: `MenuItem [*]` ↔ `FoodItem [*]` (roles: MenuItem `isUtilized`, FoodItem `utilizes`)\n   - For **one MenuItem**: uses **0..*** FoodItems.\n   - For **one FoodItem**: used by **0..*** MenuItems.\n\n10. **FoodItemAllergen**: `FoodItem [*]` ↔ `Allergen [*]` (role on Allergen end: `contains`)\n   - For **one FoodItem**: `contains` **0..*** Allergens.\n   - For **one Allergen**: can be contained in **0..*** FoodItems.\n\n11. **MenuItemChef**: `MenuItem [*]` ↔ `Chef [1]` (roles: MenuItem `designs`, Chef `designedBy`)\n   - For **one MenuItem**: `designedBy` **exactly 1** Chef.\n   - For **one Chef**: `designs` **0..*** MenuItems.\n\n12. **ChefCook**: `Chef [1]` ↔ `Cook [1..*]` (roles: Chef `underSupervisionOf`, Cook `supervises`)\n   - For **one Chef**: `underSupervisionOf` **exactly 1** Cook.\n   - For **one Cook**: `supervises` **1..*** Chefs.\n\n13. **HeadWaiterWaiter**: `HeadWaiter [1]` ↔ `Waiter [1..*]` (role on Waiter end: `responsibleFor`)\n   - For **one Waiter**: has **exactly 1** HeadWaiter.\n   - For **one HeadWaiter**: `responsibleFor` **1..*** Waiters.\n\n---\n\n## Invariants\n1. **Table capacity must be positive**\n   - Context: `Table`\n   - `self.capacity > 0`\n\n2. **Cook experience must be non-negative**\n   - Context: `Cook`\n   - `self.yearsOfExperience >= 0`\n\n3. **Restaurant owner shares must sum to 100**\n   - Context: `Restaurant`\n   - Sum of `percentageShares` across all associated owners equals 100:\n   - `self.owner->collect(o | o.percentageShares)->sum() = 100`\n   - (Interprets `self.owner` as the set of Owners linked via **RestaurantOwner**.)\n\n4. **Assigned tables must cover the reservation party size**\n   - Context: `Reservation`\n   - Total capacity of all tables assigned to the reservation must be at least `numberPeople`:\n   - `self.assignedTo->collect(t | t.capacity)->sum() >= self.numberPeople`\n\n# Category: Overconstraint Detection\nCreate an instance that represents a real-life scenario that is logically valid but violates the model's multiplicities or constraints, exposing overly restrictive or unrealistic restrictions.\n\n"
} ],
"stream" : false
}

"content" : "# Conceptual model description:\n## Description\nThis model describes a restaurant domain with people (owners, customers, workers), reservations (individual and banquet), tables, ordering, and menu composition (menu items built from food items with allergens). It also includes staff structure (head waiter/waiters, cooks/chefs) and a few business rules as invariants.\n\n### Components\n\n#### Data types\n- **Date**\n  - Operation: `Date(date : String)` (constructs a Date from a String)\n- **Time**\n  - Operation: `Time(time : String)` (constructs a Time from a String)\n\n#### Enumerations\n- **SeatingPreference**: `Inside`, `Patio`\n- **SmokingPreference**: `Smoking`, `NonSmoking`\n- **PaymentMethod**: `Cash`, `CreditCard`\n- **ItemType**: `Apetizer`, `Main`, `Dessert`, `Beverage`\n- **UnitOfMeasure**: `Ounce`, `Sheet`, `Pound`, `Gram`, `Dozen`\n- **AllergenType**: `Lactose`, `Seafood`, `Nuts`, `Gluten`\n- **Diet**: `Vegetarian`, `Vegan`, `Kosher`, `Halal`\n- **Language**: `English`, `Spanish`, `German`, `Italian`\n\n#### Classes (with attributes)\n\n- **Restaurant**\n  - `percentageShares : Integer`\n\n- **RegularCustomer** *(extends Person)*\n  - `prefferedLanguage : Language`\n\n- **DietaryRequirement**\n  - `diet : Diet`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **ReportedAllergy**\n  - `driverLicenseNr : String`\n\n---\n\n## Relationships\nFor each association, multiplicities are stated at both ends (how many instances at that end can be linked to one instance at the opposite end).\n\n1. **RestaurantOwner**: `Restaurant [1..*]` ↔ `Owner [1..*]`\n   - For **one Owner**: owns **1..*** Restaurants.\n   - For **one Restaurant**: has **1..*** Owners.\n\n2. **RestaurantReservation**: `Restaurant [0..1]` ↔ `Reservation [0..*]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: belongs to **0..1** Restaurant.\n   - For **one Reservation**: `assignedTo` **1..*** Tables.\n   - For **one Table**: assigned to **exactly 1** Reservation.\n\n7. **ReservationItemOrdered**: `Reservation [1]` ↔ `ItemOrder [0..*]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: has **0..*** ItemOrders.\n   - For **one ItemOrder**: belongs to **exactly 1** Reservation.\n\n8. **ItemOrderMenuItem**: `ItemOrder [*]` ↔ `MenuItem [1]` (role on MenuItem end: `item`)\n   - For **one ItemOrder**: refers to **exactly 1** MenuItem (`item`).\n   - For **one Chef**: `designs` **0..*** MenuItems.\n\n12. **ChefCook**: `Chef [1]` ↔ `Cook [1..*]` (roles: Chef `underSupervisionOf`, Cook `supervises`)\n   - For **one Chef**: `underSupervisionOf` **exactly 1** Cook.\n   - For **one HeadWaiter**: `responsibleFor` **1..*** Waiters.\n\n---\n\n## Invariants\n1. **Table capacity must be positive**\n   - Context: `Table`\n   - `self.capacity > 0`\n\n2. **Cook experience must be non-negative**\n   - "content" : "# Conceptual model description:\n## Description\nThis model describes a restaurant domain with people (owners, customers, workers), reservations (individual and banquet), tables, ordering, and menu composition (menu items built from food items with allergens). It also includes staff structure (head waiter/waiters, cooks/chefs) and a few business rules as invariants.\n\n### Components\n\n#### Data types\n- **Date**\n  - Operation: `Date(date : String)` (constructs a Date from a String)\n- **Time**\n  - Operation: `Time(time : String)` (constructs a Time from a String)\n\n#### Enumerations\n- **SeatingPreference**: `Inside`, `Patio`\n- **SmokingPreference**: `Smoking`, `NonSmoking`\n- **PaymentMethod**: `Cash`, `CreditCard`\n- **ItemType**: `Apetizer`, `Main`, `Dessert`, `Beverage`\n- **UnitOfMeasure**: `Ounce`, `Sheet`, `Pound`, `Gram`, `Dozen`\n- **AllergenType**: `Lactose`, `Seafood`, `Nuts`, `Gluten`\n- **Diet**: `Vegetarian`, `Vegan`, `Kosher`, `Halal`\n- **Language**: `English`, `Spanish`, `German`, `Italian`\n\n#### Classes (with attributes)\n\n- **Restaurant**\n  - `name : String`\n\n- **Reservation** *(abstract)*\n  - `time : Time`\n  - `date : Date`\n  - `numberPeople : Integer`\n  - `name : String`\n  - `phoneNumber : String`\n  - `number : Integer`\n\n- **Individual** *(extends Reservation)*\n  - `seating : SeatingPreference`\n  - `smoking : SmokingPreference`\n\n- **Banquet** *(extends Reservation)*\n  - `groupName : String`\n  - `paymentMethod : PaymentMethod`\n  - `busService : Boolean`\n\n- **Table**\n  - `number : Integer`\n  - `description : String`\n  - `capacity : Integer`\n\n- **ItemOrder**\n  - `time : Time`\n\n- **MenuItem**\n  - `description : String`\n  - `prepTime : Real`\n  - `classification : ItemType`\n\n- **FoodItem**\n  - `number : Integer`\n  - `description : String`\n  - `purchaseFlag : Boolean`\n  - `unit : UnitOfMeasure`\n\n- **Allergen**\n  - `type : AllergenType`\n\n- **Person**\n  - `name : String`\n\n- **Owner** *(extends Person)*\n  - `percentageShares : Integer`\n\n- **RegularCustomer** *(extends Person)*\n  - `prefferedLanguage : Language`\n\n- **DietaryRequirement**\n  - `diet : Diet`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **ReportedAllergy**\n  - `allergen : AllergenType`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **Worker** *(abstract, extends Person)*\n  - `dateOfBirth : Date`\n  - `phoneNumber : String`\n\n- **HeadWaiter** *(extends Worker)*\n- **Waiter** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `spokenLanguage : Language`\n- **Manager** *(extends Worker)*\n- **Cook** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `yearsOfExperience : Integer`\n- **Chef** *(extends Worker)*\n- **BusDriver** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `driverLicenseNr : String`\n\n---\n\n## Relationships\nFor each association, multiplicities are stated at both ends (how many instances at that end can be linked to one instance at the opposite end).\n\n1. **RestaurantOwner**: `Restaurant [1..*]` ↔ `Owner [1..*]`\n   - For **one Owner**: owns **1..*** Restaurants.\n   - For **one Restaurant**: has **1..*** Owners.\n\n2. **RestaurantReservation**: `Restaurant [0..1]` ↔ `Reservation [0..*]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: belongs to **0..1** Restaurant.\n   - For **one Restaurant**: has **0..*** Reservations.\n\n3. **ReservationCustomer**: `Reservation [0..*]` ↔ `RegularCustomer [0..1]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: linked to **0..1** RegularCustomer.\n   - For **one RegularCustomer**: linked to **0..*** Reservations.\n\n4. **ReservationWaiter**: `Reservation [*]` ↔ `Waiter [1..*]` (role on Waiter end: `servedBy`)\n   - For **one Reservation**: `servedBy` **1..*** Waiters.\n   - For **one Waiter**: serves **0..*** Reservations.\n\n5. **BanquetBusDriver**: `Banquet [1]` ↔ `BusDriver [0..*]`\n   - For **one Banquet**: has **0..*** BusDrivers.\n   - For **one BusDriver**: assigned to **exactly 1** Banquet.\n\n6. **ReservationTable**: `Reservation [1]` ↔ `Table [1..*]` (role on Table end: `assignedTo`)\n   - For **one Reservation**: `assignedTo` **1..*** Tables.\n   - For **one Table**: assigned to **exactly 1** Reservation.\n\n7. **ReservationItemOrdered**: `Reservation [1]` ↔ `ItemOrder [0..*]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: has **0..*** ItemOrders.\n   - For **one ItemOrder**: belongs to **exactly 1** Reservation.\n\n8. **ItemOrderMenuItem**: `ItemOrder [*]` ↔ `MenuItem [1]` (role on MenuItem end: `item`)\n   - For **one ItemOrder**: refers to **exactly 1** MenuItem (`item`).\n   - For **one MenuItem**: appears in **0..*** ItemOrders.\n\n9. **MenuItemFoodItem**: `MenuItem [*]` ↔ `FoodItem [*]` (roles: MenuItem `isUtilized`, FoodItem `utilizes`)\n   - For **one MenuItem**: uses **0..*** FoodItems.\n   - "content" : "# Conceptual model description:\n## Description\nThis model describes a restaurant domain with people (owners, customers, workers), reservations (individual and banquet), tables, ordering, and menu composition (menu items built from food items with allergens). It also includes staff structure (head waiter/waiters, cooks/chefs) and a few business rules as invariants.\n\n### Components\n\n#### Data types\n- **Date**\n  - Operation: `Date(date : String)` (constructs a Date from a String)\n- **Time**\n  - Operation: `Time(time : String)` (constructs a Time from a String)\n\n#### Enumerations\n- **SeatingPreference**: `Inside`, `Patio`\n- **SmokingPreference**: `Smoking`, `NonSmoking`\n- **PaymentMethod**: `Cash`, `CreditCard`\n- **ItemType**: `Apetizer`, `Main`, `Dessert`, `Beverage`\n- **UnitOfMeasure**: `Ounce`, `Sheet`, `Pound`, `Gram`, `Dozen`\n- **AllergenType**: `Lactose`, `Seafood`, `Nuts`, `Gluten`\n- **Diet**: `Vegetarian`, `Vegan`, `Kosher`, `Halal`\n- **Language**: `English`, `Spanish`, `German`, `Italian`\n\n#### Classes (with attributes)\n\n- **Restaurant**\n  - `name : String`\n\n- **Reservation** *(abstract)*\n  - `time : Time`\n  - `date : Date`\n  - `numberPeople : Integer`\n  - `name : String`\n  - `phoneNumber : String`\n  - `number : Integer`\n\n- **Individual** *(extends Reservation)*\n  - `seating : SeatingPreference`\n  - `smoking : SmokingPreference`\n\n- **Banquet** *(extends Reservation)*\n  - `groupName : String`\n  - `paymentMethod : PaymentMethod`\n  - `busService : Boolean`\n\n- **Table**\n  - `number : Integer`\n  - `description : String`\n  - `capacity : Integer`\n\n- **ItemOrder**\n  - `time : Time`\n\n- **MenuItem**\n  - `description : String`\n  - `prepTime : Real`\n  - `classification : ItemType`\n\n- **FoodItem**\n  - `number : Integer`\n  - `description : String`\n  - `purchaseFlag : Boolean`\n  - `unit : UnitOfMeasure`\n\n- **Allergen**\n  - `type : AllergenType`\n\n- **Person**\n  - `name : String`\n\n- **Owner** *(extends Person)*\n  - `percentageShares : Integer`\n\n- **RegularCustomer** *(extends Person)*\n  - `prefferedLanguage : Language`\n\n- **DietaryRequirement**\n  - `diet : Diet`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **ReportedAllergy**\n  - `allergen : AllergenType`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **Worker** *(abstract, extends Person)*\n  - `dateOfBirth : Date`\n  - `phoneNumber : String`\n\n- **HeadWaiter** *(extends Worker)*\n- **Waiter** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `spokenLanguage : Language`\n- **Manager** *(extends Worker)*\n- **Cook** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `yearsOfExperience : Integer`\n- **Chef** *(extends Worker)*\n- **BusDriver** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `driverLicenseNr : String`\n\n---\n\n## Relationships\nFor each association, multiplicities are stated at both ends (how many instances at that end can be linked to one instance at the opposite end).\n\n1. **RestaurantOwner**: `Restaurant [1..*]` ↔ `Owner [1..*]`\n   - For **one Owner**: owns **1..*** Restaurants.\n   - For **one Restaurant**: has **1..*** Owners.\n\n2. **RestaurantReservation**: `Restaurant [0..1]` ↔ `Reservation [0..*]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: belongs to **0..1** Restaurant.\n   - For **one Restaurant**: has **0..*** Reservations.\n\n3. **ReservationCustomer**: `Reservation [0..*]` ↔ `RegularCustomer [0..1]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: linked to **0..1** RegularCustomer.\n   - For **one RegularCustomer**: linked to **0..*** Reservations.\n\n4. **ReservationWaiter**: `Reservation [*]` ↔ `Waiter [1..*]` (role on Waiter end: `servedBy`)\n   - For **one Reservation**: `servedBy` **1..*** Waiters.\n   - For **one Waiter**: serves **0..*** Reservations.\n\n5. **BanquetBusDriver**: `Banquet [1]` ↔ `BusDriver [0..*]`\n   - For **one Banquet**: has **0..*** BusDrivers.\n   - For **one BusDriver**: assigned to **exactly 1** Banquet.\n\n6. **ReservationTable**: `Reservation [1]` ↔ `Table [1..*]` (role on Table end: `assignedTo`)\n   - For **one Reservation**: `assignedTo` **1..*** Tables.\n   - For **one Table**: assigned to **exactly 1** Reservation.\n\n7. **ReservationItemOrdered**: `Reservation [1]` ↔ `ItemOrder [0..*]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: has **0..*** ItemOrders.\n   - For **one ItemOrder**: belongs to **exactly 1** Reservation.\n\n8. **ItemOrderMenuItem**: `ItemOrder [*]` ↔ `MenuItem [1]` (role on MenuItem end: `item`)\n   - For **one ItemOrder**: refers to **exactly 1** MenuItem (`item`).\n   - For **one MenuItem**: appears in **0..*** ItemOrders.\n\n9. **MenuItemFoodItem**: `MenuItem [*]` ↔ `FoodItem [*]` (roles: MenuItem `isUtilized`, FoodItem `utilizes`)\n   - For **one MenuItem**: uses **0..*** FoodItems.\n   - For **one FoodItem**: used by **0..*** MenuItems.\n\n10. **FoodItemAllergen**: `FoodItem [*]` ↔ `Allergen [*]` (role on Allergen end: `contains`)\n   - For **one FoodItem**: `contains` **0..*** Allergens.\n   - For **one Allergen**: can be contained in **0..*** FoodItems.\n\n11. **MenuItemChef**: `MenuItem [*]` ↔ `Chef [1]` (roles: MenuItem `designs`, Chef `designedBy`)\n   - For **one MenuItem**: `designedBy` **exactly 1** Chef.\n   - For **one Chef**: `designs` **0..*** MenuItems.\n\n12. **ChefCook**: `Chef [1]` ↔ `Cook [1..*]` (roles: Chef `underSupervisionOf`, Cook `supervises`)\n   - For **one Chef**: `underSupervisionOf` **exactly 1** Cook.\n   - For **one Cook**: `supervises` **1..*** Chefs.\n\n13. **HeadWaiterWaiter**: `HeadWaiter [1]` ↔ `Waiter [1..*]` (role on Waiter end: `responsibleFor`)\n   - For **one Waiter**: has **exactly 1** HeadWaiter.\n   - For **one HeadWaiter**: `responsibleFor` **1..*** Waiters.\n\n---\n\n## Invariants\n1. **Table capacity must be positive**\n   - Context: `Table`\n   - `self.capacity > 0`\n\n2. **Cook experience must be non-negative**\n   - Context: `Cook`\n   - `self.yearsOfExperience >= 0`\n\n3. **Restaurant owner shares must sum to 100**\n   - Context: `Restaurant`\n   - Sum of `percentageShares` across all associated owners equals 100:\n   - `self.owner->collect(o | o.percentageShares)->sum() = 100`\n   - (Interprets `self.owner` as the set of Owners linked via **RestaurantOwner**.)\n\n4. **Assigned tables must cover the reservation party size**\n   - Context: `Reservation`\n   - Total capacity of all tables assigned to the reservation must be at least `numberPeople`:\n   - `self.assignedTo->collect(t | t.capacity)->sum() >= self.numberPeople`\n\n# Category: Overconstraint Detection\nCreate an instance that represents a real-life scenario that is logically valid but violates the model's multiplicities or constraints, exposing overly restrictive or unrealistic restrictions.\n\n"

The instance must adhere to these requirements:\n- Be self-contained: Include all required attributes, relationships, and related entities in full detail.\n- Conform to the model: Fulfill the constraints, multiplicities, relationships, and attributes defined in the class diagram model.\n- Understand the context: Ensure that its attributes and relationships are relevant.\n- Avoid duplication of instances: Take into consideration those instances previously built to avoid redundancy.\n- Semantic diversity: From a semantic point of view, incorporate varied scenarios, including regional, linguistic, or cultural differences.\n- Structural diversity: Include instances with different numbers of elements, different numbers of relationships and complexity, and create varied examples by changing entity attributes.\n"
}, {
"role" : "user",
"content" : "# Conceptual model description:\n## Description\nThis model describes a restaurant domain with people (owners, customers, workers), reservations (individual and banquet), tables, ordering, and menu composition (menu items built from food items with allergens). It also includes staff structure (head waiter/waiters, cooks/chefs) and a few business rules as invariants.\n\n### Components\n\n#### Data types\n- **Date**\n  - Operation: `Date(date : String)` (constructs a Date from a String)\n- **Time**\n  - Operation: `Time(time : String)` (constructs a Time from a String)\n\n#### Enumerations\n- **SeatingPreference**: `Inside`, `Patio`\n- **SmokingPreference**: `Smoking`, `NonSmoking`\n- **PaymentMethod**: `Cash`, `CreditCard`\n- **ItemType**: `Apetizer`, `Main`, `Dessert`, `Beverage`\n- **UnitOfMeasure**: `Ounce`, `Sheet`, `Pound`, `Gram`, `Dozen`\n- **AllergenType**: `Lactose`, `Seafood`, `Nuts`, `Gluten`\n- **Diet**: `Vegetarian`, `Vegan`, `Kosher`, `Halal`\n- **Language**: `English`, `Spanish`, `German`, `Italian`\n\n#### Classes (with attributes)\n\n- **Restaurant**\n  - `name : String`\n\n- **Reservation** *(abstract)*\n  - `time : Time`\n  - `date : Date`\n  - `numberPeople : Integer`\n  - `name : String`\n  - `phoneNumber : String`\n  - `number : Integer`\n\n- **Individual** *(extends Reservation)*\n  - `seating : SeatingPreference`\n  - `smoking : SmokingPreference`\n\n- **Banquet** *(extends Reservation)*\n  - `groupName : String`\n  - `paymentMethod : PaymentMethod`\n  - `busService : Boolean`\n\n- **Table**\n  - `number : Integer`\n  - `description : String`\n  - `capacity : Integer`\n\n- **ItemOrder**\n  - `time : Time`\n\n- **MenuItem**\n  - `description : String`\n  - `prepTime : Real`\n  - `classification : ItemType`\n\n- **FoodItem**\n  - `number : Integer`\n  - `description : String`\n  - `purchaseFlag : Boolean`\n  - `unit : UnitOfMeasure`\n\n- **Allergen**\n  - `type : AllergenType`\n\n- **Person**\n  - `name : String`\n\n- **Owner** *(extends Person)*\n  - `percentageShares : Integer`\n\n- **RegularCustomer** *(extends Person)*\n  - `prefferedLanguage : Language`\n\n- **DietaryRequirement**\n  - `diet : Diet`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **ReportedAllergy**\n  - `allergen : AllergenType`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **Worker** *(abstract, extends Person)*\n  - `dateOfBirth : Date`\n  - `phoneNumber : String`\n\n- **HeadWaiter** *(extends Worker)*\n- **Waiter** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `spokenLanguage : Language`\n- **Manager** *(extends Worker)*\n- **Cook** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `yearsOfExperience : Integer`\n- **Chef** *(extends Worker)*\n- **BusDriver** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `driverLicenseNr : String`\n\n---\n\n## Relationships\nFor each association, multiplicities are stated at both ends (how many instances at that end can be linked to one instance at the opposite end).\n\n1. **RestaurantOwner**: `Restaurant [1..*]` ↔ `Owner [1..*]`\n   - For **one Owner**: owns **1..*** Restaurants.\n   - For **one Restaurant**: has **1..*** Owners.\n\n2. **RestaurantReservation**: `Restaurant [0..1]` ↔ `Reservation [0..*]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: belongs to **0..1** Restaurant.\n   - For **one Restaurant**: has **0..*** Reservations.\n\n3. **ReservationCustomer**: `Reservation [0..*]` ↔ `RegularCustomer [0..1]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: linked to **0..1** RegularCustomer.\n   - For **one RegularCustomer**: linked to **0..*** Reservations.\n\n4. **ReservationWaiter**: `Reservation [*]` ↔ `Waiter [1..*]` (role on Waiter end: `servedBy`)\n   - For **one Reservation**: `servedBy` **1..*** Waiters.\n   - For **one Waiter**: serves **0..*** Reservations.\n\n5. **BanquetBusDriver**: `Banquet [1]` ↔ `BusDriver [0..*]`\n   - For **one Banquet**: has **0..*** BusDrivers.\n   - For **one BusDriver**: assigned to **exactly 1** Banquet.\n\n6. **ReservationTable**: `Reservation [1]` ↔ `Table [1..*]` (role on Table end: `assignedTo`)\n   - For **one Reservation**: `assignedTo` **1..*** Tables.\n   - For **one Table**: assigned to **exactly 1** Reservation.\n\n7. **ReservationItemOrdered**: `Reservation [1]` ↔ `ItemOrder [0..*]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: has **0..*** ItemOrders.\n   - For **one ItemOrder**: belongs to **exactly 1** Reservation.\n\n8. **ItemOrderMenuItem**: `ItemOrder [*]` ↔ `MenuItem [1]` (role on MenuItem end: `item`)\n   - For **one ItemOrder**: refers to **exactly 1** MenuItem (`item`).\n   - For **one MenuItem**: appears in **0..*** ItemOrders.\n\n9. **MenuItemFoodItem**: `MenuItem [*]` ↔ `FoodItem [*]` (roles: MenuItem `isUtilized`, FoodItem `utilizes`)\n   - For **one MenuItem**: uses **0..*** FoodItems.\n   - For **one FoodItem**: used by **0..*** MenuItems.\n\n10. **FoodItemAllergen**: `FoodItem [*]` ↔ `Allergen [*]` (role on Allergen end: `contains`)\n   - For **one FoodItem**: `contains` **0..*** Allergens.\n   - For **one Allergen**: can be contained in **0..*** FoodItems.\n\n11. **MenuItemChef**: `MenuItem [*]` ↔ `Chef [1]` (roles: MenuItem `designs`, Chef `designedBy`)\n   - For **one MenuItem**: `designedBy` **exactly 1** Chef.\n   - For **one Chef**: `designs` **0..*** MenuItems.\n\n12. **ChefCook**: `Chef [1]` ↔ `Cook [1..*]` (roles: Chef `underSupervisionOf`, Cook `supervises`)\n   - For **one Chef**: `underSupervisionOf` **exactly 1** Cook.\n   - For **one Cook**: `supervises` **1..*** Chefs.\n\n13. **HeadWaiterWaiter**: `HeadWaiter [1]` ↔ `Waiter [1..*]` (role on Waiter end: `responsibleFor`)\n   - For **one Waiter**: has **exactly 1** HeadWaiter.\n   - For **one HeadWaiter**: `responsibleFor` **1..*** Waiters.\n\n---\n\n## Invariants\n1. **Table capacity must be positive**\n   - Context: `Table`\n   - `self.capacity > 0`\n\n2. **Cook experience must be non-negative**\n   - Context: `Cook`\n   - `self.yearsOfExperience >= 0`\n\n3. **Restaurant owner shares must sum to 100**\n   - Context: `Restaurant`\n   - Sum of `percentageShares` across all associated owners equals 100:\n   - `self.owner->collect(o | o.percentageShares)->sum() = 100`\n   - (Interprets `self.owner` as the set of Owners linked via **RestaurantOwner**.)\n\n4. **Assigned tables must cover the reservation party size**\n   - Context: `Reservation`\n   - Total capacity of all tables assigned to the reservation must be at least `numberPeople`:\n   - `self.assignedTo->collect(t | t.capacity)->sum() >= self.numberPeople`\n\n# Category: Boundary Instances\nCreate a boundary case instance. This is an instance that focuses on the extreme upper or lower limits of valid input ranges. For example:\n- Upper or lower limits of multiplicities.\n- For numbers in a range, the minimum and maximum valid values.\n- Empty collections when possible, i.e., when they do not violate the semantics of the model or its constraints.\n\n"
}, {

"content" : "# Conceptual model description:\n## Description\nThis model describes a restaurant domain with people (owners, customers, workers), reservations (individual and banquet), tables, ordering, and menu composition (menu items built from food items with allergens). It also includes staff structure (head waiter/waiters, cooks/chefs) and a few business rules as invariants.\n\n### Components\n\n#### Data types\n- **Date**\n  - Operation: `Date(date : String)` (constructs a Date from a String)\n- **Time**\n  - Operation: `Time(time : String)` (constructs a Time from a String)\n\n#### Enumerations\n- **SeatingPreference**: `Inside`, `Patio`\n- **SmokingPreference**: `Smoking`, `NonSmoking`\n- **PaymentMethod**: `Cash`, `CreditCard`\n- **ItemType**: `Apetizer`, `Main`, `Dessert`, `Beverage`\n- **UnitOfMeasure**: `Ounce`, `Sheet`, `Pound`, `Gram`, `Dozen`\n- **AllergenType**: `Lactose`, `Seafood`, `Nuts`, `Gluten`\n- **Diet**: `Vegetarian`, `Vegan`, `Kosher`, `Halal`\n- **Language**: `English`, `Spanish`, `German`, `Italian`\n\n#### Classes (with attributes)\n\n- **Restaurant**\n  - `name : String`\n\n- **Reservation** *(abstract)*\n  - `time : Time`\n  - `date : Date`\n  - `numberPeople : Integer`\n  - `name : String`\n  - `phoneNumber : String`\n  - `number : Integer`\n\n- **Individual** *(extends Reservation)*\n  - `seating : SeatingPreference`\n  - `smoking : SmokingPreference`\n\n- **Banquet** *(extends Reservation)*\n  - `groupName : String`\n  - `paymentMethod : PaymentMethod`\n  - `busService : Boolean`\n\n- **Table**\n  - `number : Integer`\n  - `description : String`\n  - `capacity : Integer`\n\n- **ItemOrder**\n  - `time : Time`\n\n- **MenuItem**\n  - `description : String`\n  - `prepTime : Real`\n  - `classification : ItemType`\n\n- **FoodItem**\n  - `number : Integer`\n  - `description : String`\n  - `purchaseFlag : Boolean`\n  - `unit : UnitOfMeasure`\n\n- **Allergen**\n  - `type : AllergenType`\n\n- **Person**\n  - `name : String`\n\n- **Owner** *(extends Person)*\n  - `percentageShares : Integer`\n\n- **RegularCustomer** *(extends Person)*\n  - `prefferedLanguage : Language`\n\n- **DietaryRequirement**\n  - `diet : Diet`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **ReportedAllergy**\n  - `allergen : AllergenType`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **Worker** *(abstract, extends Person)*\n  - `dateOfBirth : Date`\n  - `phoneNumber : String`\n\n- **HeadWaiter** *(extends Worker)*\n- **Waiter** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `spokenLanguage : Language`\n- **Manager** *(extends Worker)*\n- **Cook** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `yearsOfExperience : Integer`\n- **Chef** *(extends Worker)*\n- **BusDriver** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `driverLicenseNr : String`\n\n---\n\n## Relationships\nFor each association, multiplicities are stated at both ends (how many instances at that end can be linked to one instance at the opposite end).\n\n1. **RestaurantOwner**: `Restaurant [1..*]` ↔ `Owner [1..*]`\n   - For **one Owner**: owns **1..*** Restaurants.\n   - For **one Restaurant**: has **1..*** Owners.\n\n2. **RestaurantReservation**: `Restaurant [0..1]` ↔ `Reservation [0..*]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: belongs to **0..1** Restaurant.\n   - For **one Restaurant**: has **0..*** Reservations.\n\n3. **ReservationCustomer**: `Reservation [0..*]` ↔ `RegularCustomer [0..1]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: linked to **0..1** RegularCustomer.\n   - For **one RegularCustomer**: linked to **0..*** Reservations.\n\n4. **ReservationWaiter**: `Reservation [*]` ↔ `Waiter [1..*]` (role on Waiter end: `servedBy`)\n   - For **one Reservation**: `servedBy` **1..*** Waiters.\n   - For **one Waiter**: serves **0..*** Reservations.\n\n5. **BanquetBusDriver**: `Banquet [1]` ↔ `BusDriver [0..*]`\n   - For **one Banquet**: has **0..*** BusDrivers.\n   - For **one BusDriver**: assigned to **exactly 1** Banquet.\n\n6. **ReservationTable**: `Reservation [1]` ↔ `Table [1..*]` (role on Table end: `assignedTo`)\n   - For **one Reservation**: `assignedTo` **1..*** Tables.\n   - For **one Table**: assigned to **exactly 1** Reservation.\n\n7. **ReservationItemOrdered**: `Reservation [1]` ↔ `ItemOrder [0..*]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: has **0..*** ItemOrders.\n   - For **one ItemOrder**: belongs to **exactly 1** Reservation.\n\n8. **ItemOrderMenuItem**: `ItemOrder [*]` ↔ `MenuItem [1]` (role on MenuItem end: `item`)\n   - For **one ItemOrder**: refers to **exactly 1** MenuItem (`item`).\n   - For **one MenuItem**: appears in **0..*** ItemOrders.\n\n9. **MenuItemFoodItem**: `MenuItem [*]` ↔ `FoodItem [*]` (roles: MenuItem `isUtilized`, FoodItem `utilizes`)\n   - For **one MenuItem**: uses **0..*** FoodItems.\n   - For **one FoodItem**: used by **0..*** MenuItems.\n\n10. **FoodItemAllergen**: `FoodItem [*]` ↔ `Allergen [*]` (role on Allergen end: `contains`)\n   - For **one FoodItem**: `contains` **0..*** Allergens.\n   - For **one Allergen**: can be contained in **0..*** FoodItems.\n\n11. **MenuItemChef**: `MenuItem [*]` ↔ `Chef [1]` (roles: MenuItem `designs`, Chef `designedBy`)\n   - For **one MenuItem**: `designedBy` **exactly 1** Chef.\n   - For **one Chef**: `designs` **0..*** MenuItems.\n\n12. **ChefCook**: `Chef [1]` ↔ `Cook [1..*]` (roles: Chef `underSupervisionOf`, Cook `supervises`)\n   - For **one Chef**: `underSupervisionOf` **exactly 1** Cook.\n   - For **one Cook**: `supervises` **1..*** Chefs.\n\n13. **HeadWaiterWaiter**: `HeadWaiter [1]` ↔ `Waiter [1..*]` (role on Waiter end: `responsibleFor`)\n   - For **one Waiter**: has **exactly 1** HeadWaiter.\n   - For **one HeadWaiter**: `responsibleFor` **1..*** Waiters.\n\n---\n\n## Invariants\n1. **Table capacity must be positive**\n   - Context: `Table`\n   - `self.capacity > 0`\n\n2. **Cook experience must be non-negative**\n   - Context: `Cook`\n   - `self.yearsOfExperience >= 0`\n\n3. **Restaurant owner shares must sum to 100**\n   - Context: `Restaurant`\n   - Sum of `percentageShares` across all associated owners equals 100:\n   - `self.owner->collect(o | o.percentageShares)->sum() = 100`\n   - (Interprets `self.owner` as the set of Owners linked via **RestaurantOwner**.)\n\n4. **Assigned tables must cover the reservation party size**\n   - Context: `Reservation`\n   - Total capacity of all tables assigned to the reservation must be at least `numberPeople`:\n   - `self.assignedTo->collect(t | t.capacity)->sum() >= self.numberPeople`\n\n# Category: Overconstraint Detection\nCreate an instance that represents a real-life scenario that is logically valid but violates the model's multiplicities or constraints, exposing overly restrictive or unrealistic restrictions.\n\n"

"content" : "# Conceptual model description:\n## Description\nThis model describes a restaurant domain with people (owners, customers, workers), reservations (individual and banquet), tables, ordering, and menu composition (menu items built from food items with allergens). It also includes staff structure (head waiter/waiters, cooks/chefs) and a few business rules as invariants.\n\n### Components\n\n#### Data types\n- **Date**\n  - Operation: `Date(date : String)` (constructs a Date from a String)\n- **Time**\n  - Operation: `Time(time : String)` (constructs a Time from a String)\n\n#### Enumerations\n- **SeatingPreference**: `Inside`, `Patio`\n- **SmokingPreference**: `Smoking`, `NonSmoking`\n- **PaymentMethod**: `Cash`, `CreditCard`\n- **ItemType**: `Apetizer`, `Main`, `Dessert`, `Beverage`\n- **UnitOfMeasure**: `Ounce`, `Sheet`, `Pound`, `Gram`, `Dozen`\n- **AllergenType**: `Lactose`, `Seafood`, `Nuts`, `Gluten`\n- **Diet**: `Vegetarian`, `Vegan`, `Kosher`, `Halal`\n- **Language**: `English`, `Spanish`, `German`, `Italian`\n\n#### Classes (with attributes)\n\n- **Restaurant**\n  - `name : String`\n\n- **Reservation** *(abstract)*\n  - `time : Time`\n  - `date : Date`\n  - `numberPeople : Integer`\n  - `name : String`\n  - `phoneNumber : String`\n  - `number : Integer`\n\n- **Individual** *(extends Reservation)*\n  - `seating : SeatingPreference`\n  - `smoking : SmokingPreference`\n\n- **Banquet** *(extends Reservation)*\n  - `groupName : String`\n  - `paymentMethod : PaymentMethod`\n  - `busService : Boolean`\n\n- **Table**\n  - `number : Integer`\n  - `description : String`\n  - `capacity : Integer`\n\n- **ItemOrder**\n  - `time : Time`\n\n- **MenuItem**\n  - `description : String`\n  - `prepTime : Real`\n  - `classification : ItemType`\n\n- **FoodItem**\n  - `number : Integer`\n  - `description : String`\n  - `purchaseFlag : Boolean`\n  - `unit : UnitOfMeasure`\n\n- **Allergen**\n  - `type : AllergenType`\n\n- **Person**\n  - `name : String`\n\n- **Owner** *(extends Person)*\n  - `percentageShares : Integer`\n\n- **RegularCustomer** *(extends Person)*\n  - `prefferedLanguage : Language`\n\n- **DietaryRequirement**\n  - `diet : Diet`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **ReportedAllergy**\n  - `allergen : AllergenType`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **Worker** *(abstract, extends Person)*\n  - `dateOfBirth : Date`\n  - `phoneNumber : String`\n\n- **HeadWaiter** *(extends Worker)*\n- **Waiter** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `spokenLanguage : Language`\n- **Manager** *(extends Worker)*\n- **Cook** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `yearsOfExperience : Integer`\n- **Chef** *(extends Worker)*\n- **BusDriver** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `driverLicenseNr : String`\n\n---\n\n## Relationships\nFor each association, multiplicities are stated at both ends (how many instances at that end can be linked to one instance at the opposite end).\n\n1. **RestaurantOwner**: `Restaurant [1..*]` ↔ `Owner [1..*]`\n   - For **one Owner**: owns **1..*** Restaurants.\n   - For **one Restaurant**: has **1..*** Owners.\n\n2. **RestaurantReservation**: `Restaurant [0..1]` ↔ `Reservation [0..*]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: belongs to **0..1** Restaurant.\n   - For **one Restaurant**: has **0..*** Reservations.\n\n3. **ReservationCustomer**: `Reservation [0..*]` ↔ `RegularCustomer [0..1]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: linked to **0..1** RegularCustomer.\n   - For **one Waiter**: serves **0..*** Reservations.\n\n5. **BanquetBusDriver**: `Banquet [1]` ↔ `BusDriver [0..*]`\n   - For **one Banquet**: has **0..*** BusDrivers.\n   - For **one BusDriver**: assigned to **exactly 1** Banquet.\n\n6. **ReservationTable**: `Reservation [1]` ↔ `Table [1..*]` (role on Table end: `assignedTo`)\n   - "content" : "# Conceptual model description:\n## Description\nThis model describes a restaurant domain with people (owners, customers, workers), reservations (individual and banquet), tables, ordering, and menu composition (menu items built from food items with allergens). It also includes staff structure (head waiter/waiters, cooks/chefs) and a few business rules as invariants.\n\n### Components\n\n#### Data types\n- **Date**\n  - Operation: `Date(date : String)` (constructs a Date from a String)\n- **Time**\n  - "content" : "# Conceptual model description:\n## Description\nThis model describes a restaurant domain with people (owners, customers, workers), reservations (individual and banquet), tables, ordering, and menu composition (menu items built from food items with allergens). It also includes staff structure (head waiter/waiters, cooks/chefs) and a few business rules as invariants.\n\n### Components\n\n#### Data types\n- **Date**\n  - Operation: `Date(date : String)` (constructs a Date from a String)\n- **Time**\n  - Operation: `Time(time : String)` (constructs a Time from a String)\n\n#### Enumerations\n- **SeatingPreference**: `Inside`, `Patio`\n- **SmokingPreference**: `Smoking`, `NonSmoking`\n- **PaymentMethod**: `Cash`, `CreditCard`\n- **ItemType**: `Apetizer`, `Main`, `Dessert`, `Beverage`\n- **UnitOfMeasure**: `Ounce`, `Sheet`, `Pound`, `Gram`, `Dozen`\n- **AllergenType**: `Lactose`, `Seafood`, `Nuts`, `Gluten`\n- **Diet**: `Vegetarian`, `Vegan`, `Kosher`, `Halal`\n- **Language**: `English`, `Spanish`, `German`, `Italian`\n\n#### Classes (with attributes)\n\n- **Restaurant**\n  - `name : String`\n\n- **Reservation** *(abstract)*\n  - `time : Time`\n  - `date : Date`\n  - `numberPeople : Integer`\n  - `name : String`\n  - `phoneNumber : String`\n  - `number : Integer`\n\n- **Individual** *(extends Reservation)*\n  - `seating : SeatingPreference`\n  - `smoking : SmokingPreference`\n\n- **Banquet** *(extends Reservation)*\n  - `groupName : String`\n  - `paymentMethod : PaymentMethod`\n  - `busService : Boolean`\n\n- **Table**\n  - `number : Integer`\n  - `description : String`\n  - `capacity : Integer`\n\n- **ItemOrder**\n  - `time : Time`\n\n- **MenuItem**\n  - `description : String`\n  - `prepTime : Real`\n  - `classification : ItemType`\n\n- **FoodItem**\n  - `number : Integer`\n  - `description : String`\n  - `purchaseFlag : Boolean`\n  - `unit : UnitOfMeasure`\n\n- **Allergen**\n  - `type : AllergenType`\n\n- **Person**\n  - `name : String`\n\n- **Owner** *(extends Person)*\n  - `percentageShares : Integer`\n\n- **RegularCustomer** *(extends Person)*\n  - `prefferedLanguage : Language`\n\n- **DietaryRequirement**\n  - `diet : Diet`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **ReportedAllergy**\n  - `allergen : AllergenType`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **Worker** *(abstract, extends Person)*\n  - `dateOfBirth : Date`\n  - `phoneNumber : String`\n\n- **HeadWaiter** *(extends Worker)*\n- **Waiter** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `spokenLanguage : Language`\n- **Manager** *(extends Worker)*\n- **Cook** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `yearsOfExperience : Integer`\n- **Chef** *(extends Worker)*\n- **BusDriver** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `driverLicenseNr : String`\n\n---\n\n## Relationships\nFor each association, multiplicities are stated at both ends (how many instances at that end can be linked to one instance at the opposite end).\n\n1. **RestaurantOwner**: `Restaurant [1..*]` ↔ `Owner [1..*]`\n   - For **one Owner**: owns **1..*** Restaurants.\n   - For **one Restaurant**: has **1..*** Owners.\n\n2. **RestaurantReservation**: `Restaurant [0..1]` ↔ `Reservation [0..*]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: belongs to **0..1** Restaurant.\n   - For **one Restaurant**: has **0..*** Reservations.\n\n3. **ReservationCustomer**: `Reservation [0..*]` ↔ `RegularCustomer [0..1]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: linked to **0..1** RegularCustomer.\n   - For **one RegularCustomer**: linked to **0..*** Reservations.\n\n4. **ReservationWaiter**: `Reservation [*]` ↔ `Waiter [1..*]` (role on Waiter end: `servedBy`)\n   - For **one Reservation**: `servedBy` **1..*** Waiters.\n   - For **one Waiter**: serves **0..*** Reservations.\n\n5. **BanquetBusDriver**: `Banquet [1]` ↔ `BusDriver [0..*]`\n   - For **one Banquet**: has **0..*** BusDrivers.\n   - For **one BusDriver**: assigned to **exactly 1** Banquet.\n\n6. **ReservationTable**: `Reservation [1]` ↔ `Table [1..*]` (role on Table end: `assignedTo`)\n   - For **one Reservation**: `assignedTo` **1..*** Tables.\n   - For **one Table**: assigned to **exactly 1** Reservation.\n\n7. **ReservationItemOrdered**: `Reservation [1]` ↔ `ItemOrder [0..*]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: has **0..*** ItemOrders.\n   - For **one ItemOrder**: belongs to **exactly 1** Reservation.\n\n8. **ItemOrderMenuItem**: `ItemOrder [*]` ↔ `MenuItem [1]` (role on MenuItem end: `item`)\n   - For **one ItemOrder**: refers to **exactly 1** MenuItem (`item`).\n   - For **one MenuItem**: appears in **0..*** ItemOrders.\n\n9. **MenuItemFoodItem**: `MenuItem [*]` ↔ `FoodItem [*]` (roles: MenuItem `isUtilized`, FoodItem `utilizes`)\n   - For **one MenuItem**: uses **0..*** FoodItems.\n   - For **one FoodItem**: used by **0..*** MenuItems.\n\n10. **FoodItemAllergen**: `FoodItem [*]` ↔ `Allergen [*]` (role on Allergen end: `contains`)\n   - For **one FoodItem**: `contains` **0..*** Allergens.\n   - For **one Allergen**: can be contained in **0..*** FoodItems.\n\n11. **MenuItemChef**: `MenuItem [*]` ↔ `Chef [1]` (roles: MenuItem `designs`, Chef `designedBy`)\n   - For **one MenuItem**: `designedBy` **exactly 1** Chef.\n   - For **one Chef**: `designs` **0..*** MenuItems.\n\n12. **ChefCook**: `Chef [1]` ↔ `Cook [1..*]` (roles: Chef `underSupervisionOf`, Cook `supervises`)\n   - For **one Chef**: `underSupervisionOf` **exactly 1** Cook.\n   - For **one Cook**: `supervises` **1..*** Chefs.\n\n13. **HeadWaiterWaiter**: `HeadWaiter [1]` ↔ `Waiter [1..*]` (role on Waiter end: `responsibleFor`)\n   - For **one Waiter**: has **exactly 1** HeadWaiter.\n   - For **one HeadWaiter**: `responsibleFor` **1..*** Waiters.\n\n---\n\n## Invariants\n1. **Table capacity must be positive**\n   - Context: `Table`\n   - `self.capacity > 0`\n\n2. **Cook experience must be non-negative**\n   - Context: `Cook`\n   - `self.yearsOfExperience >= 0`\n\n3. **Restaurant owner shares must sum to 100**\n   - Context: `Restaurant`\n   - Sum of `percentageShares` across all associated owners equals 100:\n   - `self.owner->collect(o | o.percentageShares)->sum() = 100`\n   - (Interprets `self.owner` as the set of Owners linked via **RestaurantOwner**.)\n\n4. **Assigned tables must cover the reservation party size**\n   - "content" : "Your task is to generate a complete and diverse instance, in plain English, for a given category and based on a provided conceptual model description. The instance must adhere to these requirements:\n- Be self-contained: Include all required attributes, relationships, and related entities in full detail.\n- Conform to the model: Fulfill the constraints, multiplicities, relationships, and attributes defined in the class diagram model.\n- Understand the context: Ensure that its attributes and relationships are relevant.\n- Avoid duplication of instances: Take into consideration those instances previously built to avoid redundancy.\n- Semantic diversity: From a semantic point of view, incorporate varied scenarios, including regional, linguistic, or cultural differences.\n- Structural diversity: Include instances with different numbers of elements, different numbers of relationships and complexity, and create varied examples by changing entity attributes.\n"
}, {
"role" : "user",
"content" : "# Conceptual model description:\n## Description\nThis model describes a restaurant domain with people (owners, customers, workers), reservations (individual and banquet), tables, ordering, and menu composition (menu items built from food items with allergens). It also includes staff structure (head waiter/waiters, cooks/chefs) and a few business rules as invariants.\n\n### Components\n\n#### Data types\n- **Date**\n  - Operation: `Date(date : String)` (constructs a Date from a String)\n- **Time**\n  - Operation: `Time(time : String)` (constructs a Time from a String)\n\n#### Enumerations\n- **SeatingPreference**: `Inside`, `Patio`\n- **SmokingPreference**: `Smoking`, `NonSmoking`\n- **PaymentMethod**: `Cash`, `CreditCard`\n- **ItemType**: `Apetizer`, `Main`, `Dessert`, `Beverage`\n- **UnitOfMeasure**: `Ounce`, `Sheet`, `Pound`, `Gram`, `Dozen`\n- **AllergenType**: `Lactose`, `Seafood`, `Nuts`, `Gluten`\n- **Diet**: `Vegetarian`, `Vegan`, `Kosher`, `Halal`\n- **Language**: `English`, `Spanish`, `German`, `Italian`\n\n#### Classes (with attributes)\n\n- **Restaurant**\n  - `name : String`\n\n- **Reservation** *(abstract)*\n  - `time : Time`\n  - `date : Date`\n  - `numberPeople : Integer`\n  - `name : String`\n  - `phoneNumber : String`\n  - `number : Integer`\n\n- **Individual** *(extends Reservation)*\n  - `seating : SeatingPreference`\n  - `smoking : SmokingPreference`\n\n- **Banquet** *(extends Reservation)*\n  - `groupName : String`\n  - `paymentMethod : PaymentMethod`\n  - `busService : Boolean`\n\n- **Table**\n  - `number : Integer`\n  - `description : String`\n  - `capacity : Integer`\n\n- **ItemOrder**\n  - `time : Time`\n\n- **MenuItem**\n  - `description : String`\n  - `prepTime : Real`\n  - `classification : ItemType`\n\n- **FoodItem**\n  - `number : Integer`\n  - `description : String`\n  - `purchaseFlag : Boolean`\n  - `unit : UnitOfMeasure`\n\n- **Allergen**\n  - `type : AllergenType`\n\n- **Person**\n  - `name : String`\n\n- **Owner** *(extends Person)*\n  - `percentageShares : Integer`\n\n- **RegularCustomer** *(extends Person)*\n  - `prefferedLanguage : Language`\n\n- **DietaryRequirement**\n  - `diet : Diet`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **ReportedAllergy**\n  - `allergen : AllergenType`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **Worker** *(abstract, extends Person)*\n  - `dateOfBirth : Date`\n  - `phoneNumber : String`\n\n- **HeadWaiter** *(extends Worker)*\n- **Waiter** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `spokenLanguage : Language`\n- **Manager** *(extends Worker)*\n- **Cook** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `yearsOfExperience : Integer`\n- **Chef** *(extends Worker)*\n- **BusDriver** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `driverLicenseNr : String`\n\n---\n\n## Relationships\nFor each association, multiplicities are stated at both ends (how many instances at that end can be linked to one instance at the opposite end).\n\n1. **RestaurantOwner**: `Restaurant [1..*]` ↔ `Owner [1..*]`\n   - For **one Owner**: owns **1..*** Restaurants.\n   - For **one Restaurant**: has **1..*** Owners.\n\n2. **RestaurantReservation**: `Restaurant [0..1]` ↔ `Reservation [0..*]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: belongs to **0..1** Restaurant.\n   - For **one Restaurant**: has **0..*** Reservations.\n\n3. **ReservationCustomer**: `Reservation [0..*]` ↔ `RegularCustomer [0..1]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: linked to **0..1** RegularCustomer.\n   - For **one RegularCustomer**: linked to **0..*** Reservations.\n\n4. **ReservationWaiter**: `Reservation [*]` ↔ `Waiter [1..*]` (role on Waiter end: `servedBy`)\n   - For **one Reservation**: `servedBy` **1..*** Waiters.\n   - For **one Waiter**: serves **0..*** Reservations.\n\n5. **BanquetBusDriver**: `Banquet [1]` ↔ `BusDriver [0..*]`\n   - For **one Banquet**: has **0..*** BusDrivers.\n   - For **one BusDriver**: assigned to **exactly 1** Banquet.\n\n6. **ReservationTable**: `Reservation [1]` ↔ `Table [1..*]` (role on Table end: `assignedTo`)\n   - For **one Reservation**: `assignedTo` **1..*** Tables.\n   - For **one Table**: assigned to **exactly 1** Reservation.\n\n7. **ReservationItemOrdered**: `Reservation [1]` ↔ `ItemOrder [0..*]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: has **0..*** ItemOrders.\n   - For **one ItemOrder**: belongs to **exactly 1** Reservation.\n\n8. **ItemOrderMenuItem**: `ItemOrder [*]` ↔ `MenuItem [1]` (role on MenuItem end: `item`)\n   - For **one ItemOrder**: refers to **exactly 1** MenuItem (`item`).\n   - For **one MenuItem**: appears in **0..*** ItemOrders.\n\n9. **MenuItemFoodItem**: `MenuItem [*]` ↔ `FoodItem [*]` (roles: MenuItem `isUtilized`, FoodItem `utilizes`)\n   - For **one MenuItem**: uses **0..*** FoodItems.\n   - For **one FoodItem**: used by **0..*** MenuItems.\n\n10. **FoodItemAllergen**: `FoodItem [*]` ↔ `Allergen [*]` (role on Allergen end: `contains`)\n   - For **one FoodItem**: `contains` **0..*** Allergens.\n   - For **one Allergen**: can be contained in **0..*** FoodItems.\n\n11. **MenuItemChef**: `MenuItem [*]` ↔ `Chef [1]` (roles: MenuItem `designs`, Chef `designedBy`)\n   - For **one MenuItem**: `designedBy` **exactly 1** Chef.\n   - For **one Chef**: `designs` **0..*** MenuItems.\n\n12. **ChefCook**: `Chef [1]` ↔ `Cook [1..*]` (roles: Chef `underSupervisionOf`, Cook `supervises`)\n   - For **one Chef**: `underSupervisionOf` **exactly 1** Cook.\n   - For **one Cook**: `supervises` **1..*** Chefs.\n\n13. **HeadWaiterWaiter**: `HeadWaiter [1]` ↔ `Waiter [1..*]` (role on Waiter end: `responsibleFor`)\n   - For **one Waiter**: has **exactly 1** HeadWaiter.\n   - For **one HeadWaiter**: `responsibleFor` **1..*** Waiters.\n\n---\n\n## Invariants\n1. **Table capacity must be positive**\n   - Context: `Table`\n   - `self.capacity > 0`\n\n2. **Cook experience must be non-negative**\n   - Context: `Cook`\n   - `self.yearsOfExperience >= 0`\n\n3. **Restaurant owner shares must sum to 100**\n   - Context: `Restaurant`\n   - Sum of `percentageShares` across all associated owners equals 100:\n   - `self.owner->collect(o | o.percentageShares)->sum() = 100`\n   - (Interprets `self.owner` as the set of Owners linked via **RestaurantOwner**.)\n\n4. **Assigned tables must cover the reservation party size**\n   - Context: `Reservation`\n   - Total capacity of all tables assigned to the reservation must be at least `numberPeople`:\n   - `self.assignedTo->collect(t | t.capacity)->sum() >= self.numberPeople`\n\n# Category: Overconstraint Detection\nCreate an instance that represents a real-life scenario that is logically valid but violates the model's multiplicities or constraints, exposing overly restrictive or unrealistic restrictions.\n\n"

"role" : "assistant",

"role" : "user",
"content" : "# Conceptual model description:\n## Description\nThis model describes a restaurant domain with people (owners, customers, workers), reservations (individual and banquet), tables, ordering, and menu composition (menu items built from food items with allergens). It also includes staff structure (head waiter/waiters, cooks/chefs) and a few business rules as invariants.\n\n### Components\n\n#### Data types\n- **Date**\n  - Operation: `Date(date : String)` (constructs a Date from a String)\n- **Time**\n  - Operation: `Time(time : String)` (constructs a Time from a String)\n\n#### Enumerations\n- **SeatingPreference**: `Inside`, `Patio`\n- **SmokingPreference**: `Smoking`, `NonSmoking`\n- **PaymentMethod**: `Cash`, `CreditCard`\n- **ItemType**: `Apetizer`, `Main`, `Dessert`, `Beverage`\n- **UnitOfMeasure**: `Ounce`, `Sheet`, `Pound`, `Gram`, `Dozen`\n- **AllergenType**: `Lactose`, `Seafood`, `Nuts`, `Gluten`\n- **Diet**: `Vegetarian`, `Vegan`, `Kosher`, `Halal`\n- **Language**: `English`, `Spanish`, `German`, `Italian`\n\n#### Classes (with attributes)\n\n- **Restaurant**\n  - `name : String`\n\n- **Reservation** *(abstract)*\n  - `time : Time`\n  - `date : Date`\n  - `numberPeople : Integer`\n  - `name : String`\n  - `phoneNumber : String`\n  - `number : Integer`\n\n- **Individual** *(extends Reservation)*\n  - `seating : SeatingPreference`\n  - `smoking : SmokingPreference`\n\n- **Banquet** *(extends Reservation)*\n  - `groupName : String`\n  - `paymentMethod : PaymentMethod`\n  - `busService : Boolean`\n\n- **Table**\n  - `number : Integer`\n  - `description : String`\n  - `capacity : Integer`\n\n- **ItemOrder**\n  - `time : Time`\n\n- **MenuItem**\n  - `description : String`\n  - `prepTime : Real`\n  - `classification : ItemType`\n\n- **FoodItem**\n  - `number : Integer`\n  - `description : String`\n  - `purchaseFlag : Boolean`\n  - `unit : UnitOfMeasure`\n\n- **Allergen**\n  - `type : AllergenType`\n\n- **Person**\n  - `name : String`\n\n- **Owner** *(extends Person)*\n  - `percentageShares : Integer`\n\n- **RegularCustomer** *(extends Person)*\n  - `prefferedLanguage : Language`\n\n- **DietaryRequirement**\n  - `diet : Diet`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **ReportedAllergy**\n  - `allergen : AllergenType`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **Worker** *(abstract, extends Person)*\n  - `dateOfBirth : Date`\n  - `phoneNumber : String`\n\n- **HeadWaiter** *(extends Worker)*\n- **Waiter** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `spokenLanguage : Language`\n- **Manager** *(extends Worker)*\n- **Cook** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `yearsOfExperience : Integer`\n- **Chef** *(extends Worker)*\n- **BusDriver** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `driverLicenseNr : String`\n\n---\n\n## Relationships\nFor each association, multiplicities are stated at both ends (how many instances at that end can be linked to one instance at the opposite end).\n\n1. **RestaurantOwner**: `Restaurant [1..*]` ↔ `Owner [1..*]`\n   - For **one Owner**: owns **1..*** Restaurants.\n   - For **one Restaurant**: has **1..*** Owners.\n\n2. **RestaurantReservation**: `Restaurant [0..1]` ↔ `Reservation [0..*]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: belongs to **0..1** Restaurant.\n   - For **one Restaurant**: has **0..*** Reservations.\n\n3. **ReservationCustomer**: `Reservation [0..*]` ↔ `RegularCustomer [0..1]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: linked to **0..1** RegularCustomer.\n   - For **one RegularCustomer**: linked to **0..*** Reservations.\n\n4. **ReservationWaiter**: `Reservation [*]` ↔ `Waiter [1..*]` (role on Waiter end: `servedBy`)\n   - For **one Reservation**: `servedBy` **1..*** Waiters.\n   - For **one Waiter**: serves **0..*** Reservations.\n\n5. **BanquetBusDriver**: `Banquet [1]` ↔ `BusDriver [0..*]`\n   - For **one Banquet**: has **0..*** BusDrivers.\n   - For **one BusDriver**: assigned to **exactly 1** Banquet.\n\n6. **ReservationTable**: `Reservation [1]` ↔ `Table [1..*]` (role on Table end: `assignedTo`)\n   - For **one Reservation**: `assignedTo` **1..*** Tables.\n   - For **one Table**: assigned to **exactly 1** Reservation.\n\n7. **ReservationItemOrdered**: `Reservation [1]` ↔ `ItemOrder [0..*]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: has **0..*** ItemOrders.\n   - "content" : "# Conceptual model description:\n## Description\nThis model describes a restaurant domain with people (owners, customers, workers), reservations (individual and banquet), tables, ordering, and menu composition (menu items built from food items with allergens). It also includes staff structure (head waiter/waiters, cooks/chefs) and a few business rules as invariants.\n\n### Components\n\n#### Data types\n- **Date**\n  - Operation: `Date(date : String)` (constructs a Date from a String)\n- **Time**\n  - Operation: `Time(time : String)` (constructs a Time from a String)\n\n#### Enumerations\n- **SeatingPreference**: `Inside`, `Patio`\n- **SmokingPreference**: `Smoking`, `NonSmoking`\n- **PaymentMethod**: `Cash`, `CreditCard`\n- **ItemType**: `Apetizer`, `Main`, `Dessert`, `Beverage`\n- **UnitOfMeasure**: `Ounce`, `Sheet`, `Pound`, `Gram`, `Dozen`\n- **AllergenType**: `Lactose`, `Seafood`, `Nuts`, `Gluten`\n- **Diet**: `Vegetarian`, `Vegan`, `Kosher`, `Halal`\n- **Language**: `English`, `Spanish`, `German`, `Italian`\n\n#### Classes (with attributes)\n\n- **Restaurant**\n  - `name : String`\n\n- **Reservation** *(abstract)*\n  - `time : Time`\n  - `date : Date`\n  - `numberPeople : Integer`\n  - `name : String`\n  - `phoneNumber : String`\n  - `number : Integer`\n\n- **Individual** *(extends Reservation)*\n  - `seating : SeatingPreference`\n  - `smoking : SmokingPreference`\n\n- **Banquet** *(extends Reservation)*\n  - `groupName : String`\n  - `paymentMethod : PaymentMethod`\n  - `busService : Boolean`\n\n- **Table**\n  - `number : Integer`\n  - `description : String`\n  - `capacity : Integer`\n\n- **ItemOrder**\n  - `time : Time`\n\n- **MenuItem**\n  - `description : String`\n  - `prepTime : Real`\n  - `classification : ItemType`\n\n- **FoodItem**\n  - `number : Integer`\n  - `description : String`\n  - `purchaseFlag : Boolean`\n  - `unit : UnitOfMeasure`\n\n- **Allergen**\n  - `type : AllergenType`\n\n- **Person**\n  - `name : String`\n\n- **Owner** *(extends Person)*\n  - `percentageShares : Integer`\n\n- **RegularCustomer** *(extends Person)*\n  - `prefferedLanguage : Language`\n\n- **DietaryRequirement**\n  - `diet : Diet`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **ReportedAllergy**\n  - `allergen : AllergenType`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **Worker** *(abstract, extends Person)*\n  - `dateOfBirth : Date`\n  - `phoneNumber : String`\n\n- **HeadWaiter** *(extends Worker)*\n- **Waiter** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `spokenLanguage : Language`\n- **Manager** *(extends Worker)*\n- **Cook** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `yearsOfExperience : Integer`\n- **Chef** *(extends Worker)*\n- **BusDriver** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `driverLicenseNr : String`\n\n---\n\n## Relationships\nFor each association, multiplicities are stated at both ends (how many instances at that end can be linked to one instance at the opposite end).\n\n1. **RestaurantOwner**: `Restaurant [1..*]` ↔ `Owner [1..*]`\n   - For **one Owner**: owns **1..*** Restaurants.\n   - For **one Restaurant**: has **1..*** Owners.\n\n2. **RestaurantReservation**: `Restaurant [0..1]` ↔ `Reservation [0..*]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: belongs to **0..1** Restaurant.\n   - For **one Restaurant**: has **0..*** Reservations.\n\n3. **ReservationCustomer**: `Reservation [0..*]` ↔ `RegularCustomer [0..1]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: linked to **0..1** RegularCustomer.\n   - For **one RegularCustomer**: linked to **0..*** Reservations.\n\n4. **ReservationWaiter**: `Reservation [*]` ↔ `Waiter [1..*]` (role on Waiter end: `servedBy`)\n   - For **one Reservation**: `servedBy` **1..*** Waiters.\n   - For **one Waiter**: serves **0..*** Reservations.\n\n5. **BanquetBusDriver**: `Banquet [1]` ↔ `BusDriver [0..*]`\n   - For **one Banquet**: has **0..*** BusDrivers.\n   - For **one BusDriver**: assigned to **exactly 1** Banquet.\n\n6. **ReservationTable**: `Reservation [1]` ↔ `Table [1..*]` (role on Table end: `assignedTo`)\n   - For **one Reservation**: `assignedTo` **1..*** Tables.\n   - For **one Table**: assigned to **exactly 1** Reservation.\n\n7. **ReservationItemOrdered**: `Reservation [1]` ↔ `ItemOrder [0..*]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: has **0..*** ItemOrders.\n   - For **one ItemOrder**: belongs to **exactly 1** Reservation.\n\n8. **ItemOrderMenuItem**: `ItemOrder [*]` ↔ `MenuItem [1]` (role on MenuItem end: `item`)\n   - For **one ItemOrder**: refers to **exactly 1** MenuItem (`item`).\n   - For **one MenuItem**: appears in **0..*** ItemOrders.\n\n9. **MenuItemFoodItem**: `MenuItem [*]` ↔ `FoodItem [*]` (roles: MenuItem `isUtilized`, FoodItem `utilizes`)\n   - For **one MenuItem**: uses **0..*** FoodItems.\n   - For **one FoodItem**: used by **0..*** MenuItems.\n\n10. **FoodItemAllergen**: `FoodItem [*]` ↔ `Allergen [*]` (role on Allergen end: `contains`)\n   - For **one FoodItem**: `contains` **0..*** Allergens.\n   - For **one Allergen**: can be contained in **0..*** FoodItems.\n\n11. **MenuItemChef**: `MenuItem [*]` ↔ `Chef [1]` (roles: MenuItem `designs`, Chef `designedBy`)\n   - For **one MenuItem**: `designedBy` **exactly 1** Chef.\n   - For **one Chef**: `designs` **0..*** MenuItems.\n\n12. **ChefCook**: `Chef [1]` ↔ `Cook [1..*]` (roles: Chef `underSupervisionOf`, Cook `supervises`)\n   - For **one Chef**: `underSupervisionOf` **exactly 1** Cook.\n   - For **one Cook**: `supervises` **1..*** Chefs.\n\n13. **HeadWaiterWaiter**: `HeadWaiter [1]` ↔ `Waiter [1..*]` (role on Waiter end: `responsibleFor`)\n   - For **one Waiter**: has **exactly 1** HeadWaiter.\n   - For **one HeadWaiter**: `responsibleFor` **1..*** Waiters.\n\n---\n\n## Invariants\n1. **Table capacity must be positive**\n   - Context: `Table`\n   - `self.capacity > 0`\n\n2. **Cook experience must be non-negative**\n   - Context: `Cook`\n   - `self.yearsOfExperience >= 0`\n\n3. **Restaurant owner shares must sum to 100**\n   - Context: `Restaurant`\n   - Sum of `percentageShares` across all associated owners equals 100:\n   - "content" : "# Conceptual model description:\n## Description\nThis model describes a restaurant domain with people (owners, customers, workers), reservations (individual and banquet), tables, ordering, and menu composition (menu items built from food items with allergens). It also includes staff structure (head waiter/waiters, cooks/chefs) and a few business rules as invariants.\n\n### Components\n\n#### Data types\n- **Date**\n  - Operation: `Date(date : String)` (constructs a Date from a String)\n- **Time**\n  - Operation: `Time(time : String)` (constructs a Time from a String)\n\n#### Enumerations\n- **SeatingPreference**: `Inside`, `Patio`\n- **SmokingPreference**: `Smoking`, `NonSmoking`\n- **PaymentMethod**: `Cash`, `CreditCard`\n- **ItemType**: `Apetizer`, `Main`, `Dessert`, `Beverage`\n- **UnitOfMeasure**: `Ounce`, `Sheet`, `Pound`, `Gram`, `Dozen`\n- **AllergenType**: `Lactose`, `Seafood`, `Nuts`, `Gluten`\n- **Diet**: `Vegetarian`, `Vegan`, `Kosher`, `Halal`\n- **Language**: `English`, `Spanish`, `German`, `Italian`\n\n#### Classes (with attributes)\n\n- **Restaurant**\n  - `name : String`\n\n- **Reservation** *(abstract)*\n  - `time : Time`\n  - `date : Date`\n  - `numberPeople : Integer`\n  - `name : String`\n  - `phoneNumber : String`\n  - `number : Integer`\n\n- **Individual** *(extends Reservation)*\n  - `seating : SeatingPreference`\n  - `smoking : SmokingPreference`\n\n- **Banquet** *(extends Reservation)*\n  - `groupName : String`\n  - `paymentMethod : PaymentMethod`\n  - `busService : Boolean`\n\n- **Table**\n  - `number : Integer`\n  - `description : String`\n  - `capacity : Integer`\n\n- **ItemOrder**\n  - `time : Time`\n\n- **MenuItem**\n  - `description : String`\n  - `prepTime : Real`\n  - `classification : ItemType`\n\n- **FoodItem**\n  - `number : Integer`\n  - `description : String`\n  - `purchaseFlag : Boolean`\n  - `unit : UnitOfMeasure`\n\n- **Allergen**\n  - `type : AllergenType`\n\n- **Person**\n  - `name : String`\n\n- **Owner** *(extends Person)*\n  - `percentageShares : Integer`\n\n- **RegularCustomer** *(extends Person)*\n  - `prefferedLanguage : Language`\n\n- **DietaryRequirement**\n  - `diet : Diet`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **ReportedAllergy**\n  - `allergen : AllergenType`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **Worker** *(abstract, extends Person)*\n  - `dateOfBirth : Date`\n  - `phoneNumber : String`\n\n- **HeadWaiter** *(extends Worker)*\n- **Waiter** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `spokenLanguage : Language`\n- **Manager** *(extends Worker)*\n- **Cook** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `yearsOfExperience : Integer`\n- **Chef** *(extends Worker)*\n- **BusDriver** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `driverLicenseNr : String`\n\n---\n\n## Relationships\nFor each association, multiplicities are stated at both ends (how many instances at that end can be linked to one instance at the opposite end).\n\n1. **RestaurantOwner**: `Restaurant [1..*]` ↔ `Owner [1..*]`\n   - For **one Owner**: owns **1..*** Restaurants.\n   - For **one Restaurant**: has **1..*** Owners.\n\n2. **RestaurantReservation**: `Restaurant [0..1]` ↔ `Reservation [0..*]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: belongs to **0..1** Restaurant.\n   - For **one Restaurant**: has **0..*** Reservations.\n\n3. **ReservationCustomer**: `Reservation [0..*]` ↔ `RegularCustomer [0..1]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: linked to **0..1** RegularCustomer.\n   - For **one RegularCustomer**: linked to **0..*** Reservations.\n\n4. **ReservationWaiter**: `Reservation [*]` ↔ `Waiter [1..*]` (role on Waiter end: `servedBy`)\n   - For **one Reservation**: `servedBy` **1..*** Waiters.\n   - For **one Waiter**: serves **0..*** Reservations.\n\n5. **BanquetBusDriver**: `Banquet [1]` ↔ `BusDriver [0..*]`\n   - For **one Banquet**: has **0..*** BusDrivers.\n   - For **one BusDriver**: assigned to **exactly 1** Banquet.\n\n6. **ReservationTable**: `Reservation [1]` ↔ `Table [1..*]` (role on Table end: `assignedTo`)\n   - For **one Reservation**: `assignedTo` **1..*** Tables.\n   - For **one Table**: assigned to **exactly 1** Reservation.\n\n7. **ReservationItemOrdered**: `Reservation [1]` ↔ `ItemOrder [0..*]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: has **0..*** ItemOrders.\n   - For **one ItemOrder**: belongs to **exactly 1** Reservation.\n\n8. **ItemOrderMenuItem**: `ItemOrder [*]` ↔ `MenuItem [1]` (role on MenuItem end: `item`)\n   - For **one ItemOrder**: refers to **exactly 1** MenuItem (`item`).\n   - For **one MenuItem**: appears in **0..*** ItemOrders.\n\n9. **MenuItemFoodItem**: `MenuItem [*]` ↔ `FoodItem [*]` (roles: MenuItem `isUtilized`, FoodItem `utilizes`)\n   - For **one MenuItem**: uses **0..*** FoodItems.\n   - For **one FoodItem**: used by **0..*** MenuItems.\n\n10. **FoodItemAllergen**: `FoodItem [*]` ↔ `Allergen [*]` (role on Allergen end: `contains`)\n   - For **one FoodItem**: `contains` **0..*** Allergens.\n   - For **one Allergen**: can be contained in **0..*** FoodItems.\n\n11. **MenuItemChef**: `MenuItem [*]` ↔ `Chef [1]` (roles: MenuItem `designs`, Chef `designedBy`)\n   - For **one MenuItem**: `designedBy` **exactly 1** Chef.\n   - For **one Chef**: `designs` **0..*** MenuItems.\n\n12. **ChefCook**: `Chef [1]` ↔ `Cook [1..*]` (roles: Chef `underSupervisionOf`, Cook `supervises`)\n   - For **one Chef**: `underSupervisionOf` **exactly 1** Cook.\n   - For **one Cook**: `supervises` **1..*** Chefs.\n\n13. **HeadWaiterWaiter**: `HeadWaiter [1]` ↔ `Waiter [1..*]` (role on Waiter end: `responsibleFor`)\n   - For **one Waiter**: has **exactly 1** HeadWaiter.\n   - For **one HeadWaiter**: `responsibleFor` **1..*** Waiters.\n\n---\n\n## Invariants\n1. **Table capacity must be positive**\n   - Context: `Table`\n   - `self.capacity > 0`\n\n2. **Cook experience must be non-negative**\n   - Context: `Cook`\n   - `self.yearsOfExperience >= 0`\n\n3. **Restaurant owner shares must sum to 100**\n   - Context: `Restaurant`\n   - Sum of `percentageShares` across all associated owners equals 100:\n   - `self.owner->collect(o | o.percentageShares)->sum() = 100`\n   - (Interprets `self.owner` as the set of Owners linked via **RestaurantOwner**.)\n\n4. **Assigned tables must cover the reservation party size**\n   - Context: `Reservation`\n   - Total capacity of all tables assigned to the reservation must be at least `numberPeople`:\n   - `self.assignedTo->collect(t | t.capacity)->sum() >= self.numberPeople`\n\n# Category: Overconstraint Detection\nCreate an instance that represents a real-life scenario that is logically valid but violates the model's multiplicities or constraints, exposing overly restrictive or unrealistic restrictions.\n\n"

"content" : "# Conceptual model description:\n## Description\nThis model describes a restaurant domain with people (owners, customers, workers), reservations (individual and banquet), tables, ordering, and menu composition (menu items built from food items with allergens). Operation: `Time(time : String)` (constructs a Time from a String)\n\n#### Enumerations\n- **SeatingPreference**: `Inside`, `Patio`\n- **SmokingPreference**: `Smoking`, `NonSmoking`\n- **PaymentMethod**: `Cash`, `CreditCard`\n- **ItemType**: `Apetizer`, `Main`, `Dessert`, `Beverage`\n- **UnitOfMeasure**: `Ounce`, `Sheet`, `Pound`, `Gram`, `Dozen`\n- **AllergenType**: `Lactose`, `Seafood`, `Nuts`, `Gluten`\n- **Diet**: `Vegetarian`, `Vegan`, `Kosher`, `Halal`\n- **Language**: `English`, `Spanish`, `German`, `Italian`\n\n#### Classes (with attributes)\n\n- **Restaurant**\n  - "content" : "# Conceptual model description:\n## Description\nThis model describes a restaurant domain with people (owners, customers, workers), reservations (individual and banquet), tables, ordering, and menu composition (menu items built from food items with allergens). It also includes staff structure (head waiter/waiters, cooks/chefs) and a few business rules as invariants.\n\n### Components\n\n#### Data types\n- **Date**\n  - Operation: `Date(date : String)` (constructs a Date from a String)\n- **Time**\n  - Operation: `Time(time : String)` (constructs a Time from a String)\n\n#### Enumerations\n- **SeatingPreference**: `Inside`, `Patio`\n- **SmokingPreference**: `Smoking`, `NonSmoking`\n- **PaymentMethod**: `Cash`, `CreditCard`\n- **ItemType**: `Apetizer`, `Main`, `Dessert`, `Beverage`\n- **UnitOfMeasure**: `Ounce`, `Sheet`, `Pound`, `Gram`, `Dozen`\n- **AllergenType**: `Lactose`, `Seafood`, `Nuts`, `Gluten`\n- **Diet**: `Vegetarian`, `Vegan`, `Kosher`, `Halal`\n- **Language**: `English`, `Spanish`, `German`, `Italian`\n\n#### Classes (with attributes)\n\n- **Restaurant**\n  - `name : String`\n\n- **Reservation** *(abstract)*\n  - `time : Time`\n  - `date : Date`\n  - `numberPeople : Integer`\n  - `name : String`\n  - `phoneNumber : String`\n  - `number : Integer`\n\n- **Individual** *(extends Reservation)*\n  - `seating : SeatingPreference`\n  - `smoking : SmokingPreference`\n\n- **Banquet** *(extends Reservation)*\n  - `groupName : String`\n  - `paymentMethod : PaymentMethod`\n  - `busService : Boolean`\n\n- **Table**\n  - `number : Integer`\n  - `description : String`\n  - `capacity : Integer`\n\n- **ItemOrder**\n  - `time : Time`\n\n- **MenuItem**\n  - `description : String`\n  - `prepTime : Real`\n  - `classification : ItemType`\n\n- **FoodItem**\n  - `number : Integer`\n  - `description : String`\n  - `purchaseFlag : Boolean`\n  - `unit : UnitOfMeasure`\n\n- **Allergen**\n  - `type : AllergenType`\n\n- **Person**\n  - `name : String`\n\n- **Owner** *(extends Person)*\n  - `percentageShares : Integer`\n\n- **RegularCustomer** *(extends Person)*\n  - `prefferedLanguage : Language`\n\n- **DietaryRequirement**\n  - `diet : Diet`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **ReportedAllergy**\n  - `allergen : AllergenType`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **Worker** *(abstract, extends Person)*\n  - `dateOfBirth : Date`\n  - `phoneNumber : String`\n\n- **HeadWaiter** *(extends Worker)*\n- **Waiter** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `spokenLanguage : Language`\n- **Manager** *(extends Worker)*\n- **Cook** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `yearsOfExperience : Integer`\n- **Chef** *(extends Worker)*\n- **BusDriver** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `driverLicenseNr : String`\n\n---\n\n## Relationships\nFor each association, multiplicities are stated at both ends (how many instances at that end can be linked to one instance at the opposite end).\n\n1. **RestaurantOwner**: `Restaurant [1..*]` ↔ `Owner [1..*]`\n   - For **one Owner**: owns **1..*** Restaurants.\n   - For **one Restaurant**: has **1..*** Owners.\n\n2. **RestaurantReservation**: `Restaurant [0..1]` ↔ `Reservation [0..*]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: belongs to **0..1** Restaurant.\n   - For **one Restaurant**: has **0..*** Reservations.\n\n3. **ReservationCustomer**: `Reservation [0..*]` ↔ `RegularCustomer [0..1]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: linked to **0..1** RegularCustomer.\n   - For **one RegularCustomer**: linked to **0..*** Reservations.\n\n4. **ReservationWaiter**: `Reservation [*]` ↔ `Waiter [1..*]` (role on Waiter end: `servedBy`)\n   - For **one Reservation**: `servedBy` **1..*** Waiters.\n   - For **one Waiter**: serves **0..*** Reservations.\n\n5. **BanquetBusDriver**: `Banquet [1]` ↔ `BusDriver [0..*]`\n   - For **one Banquet**: has **0..*** BusDrivers.\n   - For **one BusDriver**: assigned to **exactly 1** Banquet.\n\n6. **ReservationTable**: `Reservation [1]` ↔ `Table [1..*]` (role on Table end: `assignedTo`)\n   - For **one Reservation**: `assignedTo` **1..*** Tables.\n   - For **one Table**: assigned to **exactly 1** Reservation.\n\n7. **ReservationItemOrdered**: `Reservation [1]` ↔ `ItemOrder [0..*]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: has **0..*** ItemOrders.\n   - For **one ItemOrder**: belongs to **exactly 1** Reservation.\n\n8. **ItemOrderMenuItem**: `ItemOrder [*]` ↔ `MenuItem [1]` (role on MenuItem end: `item`)\n   - For **one ItemOrder**: refers to **exactly 1** MenuItem (`item`).\n   - For **one MenuItem**: appears in **0..*** ItemOrders.\n\n9. **MenuItemFoodItem**: `MenuItem [*]` ↔ `FoodItem [*]` (roles: MenuItem `isUtilized`, FoodItem `utilizes`)\n   - For **one MenuItem**: uses **0..*** FoodItems.\n   - For **one FoodItem**: used by **0..*** MenuItems.\n\n10. **FoodItemAllergen**: `FoodItem [*]` ↔ `Allergen [*]` (role on Allergen end: `contains`)\n   - For **one FoodItem**: `contains` **0..*** Allergens.\n   - For **one Allergen**: can be contained in **0..*** FoodItems.\n\n11. **MenuItemChef**: `MenuItem [*]` ↔ `Chef [1]` (roles: MenuItem `designs`, Chef `designedBy`)\n   - For **one MenuItem**: `designedBy` **exactly 1** Chef.\n   - For **one Chef**: `designs` **0..*** MenuItems.\n\n12. **ChefCook**: `Chef [1]` ↔ `Cook [1..*]` (roles: Chef `underSupervisionOf`, Cook `supervises`)\n   - For **one Chef**: `underSupervisionOf` **exactly 1** Cook.\n   - For **one Cook**: `supervises` **1..*** Chefs.\n\n13. **HeadWaiterWaiter**: `HeadWaiter [1]` ↔ `Waiter [1..*]` (role on Waiter end: `responsibleFor`)\n   - For **one Waiter**: has **exactly 1** HeadWaiter.\n   - For **one HeadWaiter**: `responsibleFor` **1..*** Waiters.\n\n---\n\n## Invariants\n1. **Table capacity must be positive**\n   - Context: `Table`\n   - `self.capacity > 0`\n\n2. **Cook experience must be non-negative**\n   - Context: `Cook`\n   - `self.yearsOfExperience >= 0`\n\n3. **Restaurant owner shares must sum to 100**\n   - Context: `Restaurant`\n   - Sum of `percentageShares` across all associated owners equals 100:\n   - `self.owner->collect(o | o.percentageShares)->sum() = 100`\n   - (Interprets `self.owner` as the set of Owners linked via **RestaurantOwner**.)\n\n4. **Assigned tables must cover the reservation party size**\n   -
