"content" : "# Conceptual model description:\n## Description\nThis model describes a restaurant domain with people (owners, customers, workers), reservations (individual and banquet), tables, ordering, and menu composition (menu items built from food items with allergens). It also includes staff structure (head waiter/waiters, cooks/chefs) and a few business rules as invariants.\n\n### Components\n\n#### Data types\n- **Date**\n  - Operation: `Date(date : String)` (constructs a Date from a String)\n- **Time**\n  - Operation: `Time(time : String)` (constructs a Time from a String)\n\n#### Enumerations\n- **SeatingPreference**: `Inside`, `Patio`\n- **SmokingPreference**: `Smoking`, `NonSmoking`\n- **PaymentMethod**: `Cash`, `CreditCard`\n- **ItemType**: `Apetizer`, `Main`, `Dessert`, `Beverage`\n- **UnitOfMeasure**: `Ounce`, `Sheet`, `Pound`, `Gram`, `Dozen`\n- **AllergenType**: `Lactose`, `Seafood`, `Nuts`, `Gluten`\n- **Diet**: `Vegetarian`, `Vegan`, `Kosher`, `Halal`\n- **Language**: `English`, `Spanish`, `German`, `Italian`\n\n#### Classes (with attributes)\n\n- **Restaurant**\n  - `name : String`\n\n- **Reservation** *(abstract)*\n  - `time : Time`\n  - `date : Date`\n  - `numberPeople : Integer`\n  - `name : String`\n  - `phoneNumber : String`\n  - `number : Integer`\n\n- **Individual** *(extends Reservation)*\n  - `seating : SeatingPreference`\n  - `smoking : SmokingPreference`\n\n- **Banquet** *(extends Reservation)*\n  - `groupName : String`\n  - `paymentMethod : PaymentMethod`\n  - `busService : Boolean`\n\n- **Table**\n  - `number : Integer`\n  - `description : String`\n  - `capacity : Integer`\n\n- **ItemOrder**\n  - `time : Time`\n\n- **MenuItem**\n  - `description : String`\n  - `prepTime : Real`\n  - `classification : ItemType`\n\n- **FoodItem**\n  - `number : Integer`\n  - `description : String`\n  - `purchaseFlag : Boolean`\n  - `unit : UnitOfMeasure`\n\n- **Allergen**\n  - `type : AllergenType`\n\n- **Person**\n  - `name : String`\n\n- **Owner** *(extends Person)*\n  - `percentageShares : Integer`\n\n- **RegularCustomer** *(extends Person)*\n  - `prefferedLanguage : Language`\n\n- **DietaryRequirement**\n  - `diet : Diet`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **ReportedAllergy**\n  - `allergen : AllergenType`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **Worker** *(abstract, extends Person)*\n  - `dateOfBirth : Date`\n  - `phoneNumber : String`\n\n- **HeadWaiter** *(extends Worker)*\n- **Waiter** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `spokenLanguage : Language`\n- **Manager** *(extends Worker)*\n- **Cook** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `yearsOfExperience : Integer`\n- **Chef** *(extends Worker)*\n- **BusDriver** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `driverLicenseNr : String`\n\n---\n\n## Relationships\nFor each association, multiplicities are stated at both ends (how many instances at that end can be linked to one instance at the opposite end).\n\n1. **RestaurantOwner**: `Restaurant [1..*]` ↔ `Owner [1..*]`\n   - For **one Owner**: owns **1..*** Restaurants.\n   - For **one Restaurant**: has **1..*** Owners.\n\n2. **RestaurantReservation**: `Restaurant [0..1]` ↔ `Reservation [0..*]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: belongs to **0..1** Restaurant.\n   - For **one Restaurant**: has **0..*** Reservations.\n\n3. **ReservationCustomer**: `Reservation [0..*]` ↔ `RegularCustomer [0..1]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: linked to **0..1** RegularCustomer.\n   - For **one RegularCustomer**: linked to **0..*** Reservations.\n\n4. **ReservationWaiter**: `Reservation [*]` ↔ `Waiter [1..*]` (role on Waiter end: `servedBy`)\n   - For **one Reservation**: `servedBy` **1..*** Waiters.\n   - For **one Waiter**: serves **0..*** Reservations.\n\n5. **BanquetBusDriver**: `Banquet [1]` ↔ `BusDriver [0..*]`\n   - For **one Banquet**: has **0..*** BusDrivers.\n   - For **one BusDriver**: assigned to **exactly 1** Banquet.\n\n6. **ReservationTable**: `Reservation [1]` ↔ `Table [1..*]` (role on Table end: `assignedTo`)\n   - For **one Reservation**: `assignedTo` **1..*** Tables.\n   - For **one Table**: assigned to **exactly 1** Reservation.\n\n7. **ReservationItemOrdered**: `Reservation [1]` ↔ `ItemOrder [0..*]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: has **0..*** ItemOrders.\n   - For **one ItemOrder**: belongs to **exactly 1** Reservation.\n\n8. **ItemOrderMenuItem**: `ItemOrder [*]` ↔ `MenuItem [1]` (role on MenuItem end: `item`)\n   - For **one ItemOrder**: refers to **exactly 1** MenuItem (`item`).\n   - For **one MenuItem**: appears in **0..*** ItemOrders.\n\n9. **MenuItemFoodItem**: `MenuItem [*]` ↔ `FoodItem [*]` (roles: MenuItem `isUtilized`, FoodItem `utilizes`)\n   - For **one MenuItem**: uses **0..*** FoodItems.\n   - For **one FoodItem**: used by **0..*** MenuItems.\n\n10. **FoodItemAllergen**: `FoodItem [*]` ↔ `Allergen [*]` (role on Allergen end: `contains`)\n   - For **one FoodItem**: `contains` **0..*** Allergens.\n   - "content" : "# Conceptual model description:\n## Description\nThis model describes a restaurant domain with people (owners, customers, workers), reservations (individual and banquet), tables, ordering, and menu composition (menu items built from food items with allergens). It also includes staff structure (head waiter/waiters, cooks/chefs) and a few business rules as invariants.\n\n### Components\n\n#### Data types\n- **Date**\n  - Operation: `Date(date : String)` (constructs a Date from a String)\n- **Time**\n  - Operation: `Time(time : String)` (constructs a Time from a String)\n\n#### Enumerations\n- **SeatingPreference**: `Inside`, `Patio`\n- **SmokingPreference**: `Smoking`, `NonSmoking`\n- **PaymentMethod**: `Cash`, `CreditCard`\n- **ItemType**: `Apetizer`, `Main`, `Dessert`, `Beverage`\n- **UnitOfMeasure**: `Ounce`, `Sheet`, `Pound`, `Gram`, `Dozen`\n- **AllergenType**: `Lactose`, `Seafood`, `Nuts`, `Gluten`\n- **Diet**: `Vegetarian`, `Vegan`, `Kosher`, `Halal`\n- **Language**: `English`, `Spanish`, `German`, `Italian`\n\n#### Classes (with attributes)\n\n- **Restaurant**\n  - `name : String`\n\n- **Reservation** *(abstract)*\n  - `time : Time`\n  - `date : Date`\n  - `numberPeople : Integer`\n  - `name : String`\n  - `phoneNumber : String`\n  - `number : Integer`\n\n- **Individual** *(extends Reservation)*\n  - `seating : SeatingPreference`\n  - `smoking : SmokingPreference`\n\n- **Banquet** *(extends Reservation)*\n  - `groupName : String`\n  - `paymentMethod : PaymentMethod`\n  - `busService : Boolean`\n\n- **Table**\n  - `number : Integer`\n  - `description : String`\n  - `capacity : Integer`\n\n- **ItemOrder**\n  - `time : Time`\n\n- **MenuItem**\n  - `description : String`\n  - `prepTime : Real`\n  - `classification : ItemType`\n\n- **FoodItem**\n  - `number : Integer`\n  - `description : String`\n  - `purchaseFlag : Boolean`\n  - `unit : UnitOfMeasure`\n\n- **Allergen**\n  - `type : AllergenType`\n\n- **Person**\n  - `name : String`\n\n- **Owner** *(extends Person)*\n  - `percentageShares : Integer`\n\n- **RegularCustomer** *(extends Person)*\n  - `prefferedLanguage : Language`\n\n- **DietaryRequirement**\n  - `diet : Diet`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **ReportedAllergy**\n  - `allergen : AllergenType`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **Worker** *(abstract, extends Person)*\n  - `dateOfBirth : Date`\n  - `phoneNumber : String`\n\n- **HeadWaiter** *(extends Worker)*\n- **Waiter** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `spokenLanguage : Language`\n- **Manager** *(extends Worker)*\n- **Cook** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `yearsOfExperience : Integer`\n- **Chef** *(extends Worker)*\n- **BusDriver** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `driverLicenseNr : String`\n\n---\n\n## Relationships\nFor each association, multiplicities are stated at both ends (how many instances at that end can be linked to one instance at the opposite end).\n\n1. **RestaurantOwner**: `Restaurant [1..*]` ↔ `Owner [1..*]`\n   - "content" : "# Conceptual model description:\n## Description\nThis model describes a restaurant domain with people (owners, customers, workers), reservations (individual and banquet), tables, ordering, and menu composition (menu items built from food items with allergens). It also includes staff structure (head waiter/waiters, cooks/chefs) and a few business rules as invariants.\n\n### Components\n\n#### Data types\n- **Date**\n  - Operation: `Date(date : String)` (constructs a Date from a String)\n- **Time**\n  - Operation: `Time(time : String)` (constructs a Time from a String)\n\n#### Enumerations\n- **SeatingPreference**: `Inside`, `Patio`\n- **SmokingPreference**: `Smoking`, `NonSmoking`\n- **PaymentMethod**: `Cash`, `CreditCard`\n- **ItemType**: `Apetizer`, `Main`, `Dessert`, `Beverage`\n- **UnitOfMeasure**: `Ounce`, `Sheet`, `Pound`, `Gram`, `Dozen`\n- **AllergenType**: `Lactose`, `Seafood`, `Nuts`, `Gluten`\n- **Diet**: `Vegetarian`, `Vegan`, `Kosher`, `Halal`\n- **Language**: `English`, `Spanish`, `German`, `Italian`\n\n#### Classes (with attributes)\n\n- **Restaurant**\n  - `name : String`\n\n- **Reservation** *(abstract)*\n  - `time : Time`\n  - `date : Date`\n  - `numberPeople : Integer`\n  - `name : String`\n  - `phoneNumber : String`\n  - `number : Integer`\n\n- **Individual** *(extends Reservation)*\n  - `seating : SeatingPreference`\n  - `smoking : SmokingPreference`\n\n- **Banquet** *(extends Reservation)*\n  - `groupName : String`\n  - `paymentMethod : PaymentMethod`\n  - `busService : Boolean`\n\n- **Table**\n  - `number : Integer`\n  - `description : String`\n  - `capacity : Integer`\n\n- **ItemOrder**\n  - `time : Time`\n\n- **MenuItem**\n  - `description : String`\n  - `prepTime : Real`\n  - `classification : ItemType`\n\n- **FoodItem**\n  - `number : Integer`\n  - `description : String`\n  - `purchaseFlag : Boolean`\n  - `unit : UnitOfMeasure`\n\n- **Allergen**\n  - `type : AllergenType`\n\n- **Person**\n  - `name : String`\n\n- **Owner** *(extends Person)*\n  - `percentageShares : Integer`\n\n- **RegularCustomer** *(extends Person)*\n  - `prefferedLanguage : Language`\n\n- **DietaryRequirement**\n  - `diet : Diet`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **ReportedAllergy**\n  - `allergen : AllergenType`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **Worker** *(abstract, extends Person)*\n  - `dateOfBirth : Date`\n  - `phoneNumber : String`\n\n- **HeadWaiter** *(extends Worker)*\n- **Waiter** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `spokenLanguage : Language`\n- **Manager** *(extends Worker)*\n- **Cook** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `yearsOfExperience : Integer`\n- **Chef** *(extends Worker)*\n- **BusDriver** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `driverLicenseNr : String`\n\n---\n\n## Relationships\nFor each association, multiplicities are stated at both ends (how many instances at that end can be linked to one instance at the opposite end).\n\n1. **RestaurantOwner**: `Restaurant [1..*]` ↔ `Owner [1..*]`\n   - "content" : "# Conceptual model description:\n## Description\nThis model describes a restaurant domain with people (owners, customers, workers), reservations (individual and banquet), tables, ordering, and menu composition (menu items built from food items with allergens). It also includes staff structure (head waiter/waiters, cooks/chefs) and a few business rules as invariants.\n\n### Components\n\n#### Data types\n- **Date**\n  - Operation: `Date(date : String)` (constructs a Date from a String)\n- **Time**\n  - Operation: `Time(time : String)` (constructs a Time from a String)\n\n#### Enumerations\n- **SeatingPreference**: `Inside`, `Patio`\n- **SmokingPreference**: `Smoking`, `NonSmoking`\n- **PaymentMethod**: `Cash`, `CreditCard`\n- **ItemType**: `Apetizer`, `Main`, `Dessert`, `Beverage`\n- **UnitOfMeasure**: `Ounce`, `Sheet`, `Pound`, `Gram`, `Dozen`\n- **AllergenType**: `Lactose`, `Seafood`, `Nuts`, `Gluten`\n- **Diet**: `Vegetarian`, `Vegan`, `Kosher`, `Halal`\n- **Language**: `English`, `Spanish`, `German`, `Italian`\n\n#### Classes (with attributes)\n\n- **Restaurant**\n  - `name : String`\n\n- **Reservation** *(abstract)*\n  - `time : Time`\n  - `date : Date`\n  - `numberPeople : Integer`\n  - `name : String`\n  - `phoneNumber : String`\n  - `number : Integer`\n\n- **Individual** *(extends Reservation)*\n  - `seating : SeatingPreference`\n  - `smoking : SmokingPreference`\n\n- **Banquet** *(extends Reservation)*\n  - `groupName : String`\n  - `paymentMethod : PaymentMethod`\n  - `busService : Boolean`\n\n- **Table**\n  - `number : Integer`\n  - `description : String`\n  - `capacity : Integer`\n\n- **ItemOrder**\n  - `time : Time`\n\n- **MenuItem**\n  - `description : String`\n  - `prepTime : Real`\n  - `classification : ItemType`\n\n- **FoodItem**\n  - `number : Integer`\n  - `description : String`\n  - `purchaseFlag : Boolean`\n  - `unit : UnitOfMeasure`\n\n- **Allergen**\n  - `type : AllergenType`\n\n- **Person**\n  - `name : String`\n\n- **Owner** *(extends Person)*\n  - `percentageShares : Integer`\n\n- **RegularCustomer** *(extends Person)*\n  - `prefferedLanguage : Language`\n\n- **DietaryRequirement**\n  - `diet : Diet`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **ReportedAllergy**\n  - `allergen : AllergenType`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **Worker** *(abstract, extends Person)*\n  - `dateOfBirth : Date`\n  - `phoneNumber : String`\n\n- **HeadWaiter** *(extends Worker)*\n- **Waiter** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `spokenLanguage : Language`\n- **Manager** *(extends Worker)*\n- **Cook** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `yearsOfExperience : Integer`\n- **Chef** *(extends Worker)*\n- **BusDriver** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `driverLicenseNr : String`\n\n---\n\n## Relationships\nFor each association, multiplicities are stated at both ends (how many instances at that end can be linked to one instance at the opposite end).\n\n1. **RestaurantOwner**: `Restaurant [1..*]` ↔ `Owner [1..*]`\n   - For **one Owner**: owns **1..*** Restaurants.\n   - For **one Restaurant**: has **1..*** Owners.\n\n2. **RestaurantReservation**: `Restaurant [0..1]` ↔ `Reservation [0..*]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: belongs to **0..1** Restaurant.\n   - "content" : "# Conceptual model description:\n## Description\nThis model describes a restaurant domain with people (owners, customers, workers), reservations (individual and banquet), tables, ordering, and menu composition (menu items built from food items with allergens). It also includes staff structure (head waiter/waiters, cooks/chefs) and a few business rules as invariants.\n\n### Components\n\n#### Data types\n- **Date**\n  - Operation: `Date(date : String)` (constructs a Date from a String)\n- **Time**\n  - Operation: `Time(time : String)` (constructs a Time from a String)\n\n#### Enumerations\n- **SeatingPreference**: `Inside`, `Patio`\n- **SmokingPreference**: `Smoking`, `NonSmoking`\n- **PaymentMethod**: `Cash`, `CreditCard`\n- **ItemType**: `Apetizer`, `Main`, `Dessert`, `Beverage`\n- **UnitOfMeasure**: `Ounce`, `Sheet`, `Pound`, `Gram`, `Dozen`\n- **AllergenType**: `Lactose`, `Seafood`, `Nuts`, `Gluten`\n- **Diet**: `Vegetarian`, `Vegan`, `Kosher`, `Halal`\n- **Language**: `English`, `Spanish`, `German`, `Italian`\n\n#### Classes (with attributes)\n\n- **Restaurant**\n  - `name : String`\n\n- **Reservation** *(abstract)*\n  - `time : Time`\n  - `date : Date`\n  - `numberPeople : Integer`\n  - `name : String`\n  - `phoneNumber : String`\n  - `number : Integer`\n\n- **Individual** *(extends Reservation)*\n  - `seating : SeatingPreference`\n  - `smoking : SmokingPreference`\n\n- **Banquet** *(extends Reservation)*\n  - `groupName : String`\n  - `paymentMethod : PaymentMethod`\n  - `busService : Boolean`\n\n- **Table**\n  - `number : Integer`\n  - `description : String`\n  - `capacity : Integer`\n\n- **ItemOrder**\n  - `time : Time`\n\n- **MenuItem**\n  - `description : String`\n  - `prepTime : Real`\n  - `classification : ItemType`\n\n- **FoodItem**\n  - `number : Integer`\n  - `description : String`\n  - `purchaseFlag : Boolean`\n  - `unit : UnitOfMeasure`\n\n- **Allergen**\n  - `type : AllergenType`\n\n- **Person**\n  - `name : String`\n\n- **Owner** *(extends Person)*\n  - `percentageShares : Integer`\n\n- **RegularCustomer** *(extends Person)*\n  - `prefferedLanguage : Language`\n\n- **DietaryRequirement**\n  - `diet : Diet`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **ReportedAllergy**\n  - `allergen : AllergenType`\n  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)\n\n- **Worker** *(abstract, extends Person)*\n  - `dateOfBirth : Date`\n  - `phoneNumber : String`\n\n- **HeadWaiter** *(extends Worker)*\n- **Waiter** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `spokenLanguage : Language`\n- **Manager** *(extends Worker)*\n- **Cook** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `yearsOfExperience : Integer`\n- **Chef** *(extends Worker)*\n- **BusDriver** *(extends Worker)*\n  - `driverLicenseNr : String`\n\n---\n\n## Relationships\nFor each association, multiplicities are stated at both ends (how many instances at that end can be linked to one instance at the opposite end).\n\n1. **RestaurantOwner**: `Restaurant [1..*]` ↔ `Owner [1..*]`\n   - For **one Owner**: owns **1..*** Restaurants.\n   - For **one Restaurant**: has **1..*** Owners.\n\n2. **RestaurantReservation**: `Restaurant [0..1]` ↔ `Reservation [0..*]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: belongs to **0..1** Restaurant.\n   - For **one Restaurant**: has **0..*** Reservations.\n\n3. **ReservationCustomer**: `Reservation [0..*]` ↔ `RegularCustomer [0..1]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: linked to **0..1** RegularCustomer.\n   - For **one RegularCustomer**: linked to **0..*** Reservations.\n\n4. **ReservationWaiter**: `Reservation [*]` ↔ `Waiter [1..*]` (role on Waiter end: `servedBy`)\n   - For **one Reservation**: `servedBy` **1..*** Waiters.\n   - For **one Waiter**: serves **0..*** Reservations.\n\n5. **BanquetBusDriver**: `Banquet [1]` ↔ `BusDriver [0..*]`\n   - For **one Banquet**: has **0..*** BusDrivers.\n   - For **one BusDriver**: assigned to **exactly 1** Banquet.\n\n6. **ReservationTable**: `Reservation [1]` ↔ `Table [1..*]` (role on Table end: `assignedTo`)\n   - For **one Reservation**: `assignedTo` **1..*** Tables.\n   - For **one Table**: assigned to **exactly 1** Reservation.\n\n7. **ReservationItemOrdered**: `Reservation [1]` ↔ `ItemOrder [0..*]`\n   - For **one Reservation**: has **0..*** ItemOrders.\n   - For **one ItemOrder**: belongs to **exactly 1** Reservation.\n\n8. **ItemOrderMenuItem**: `ItemOrder [*]` ↔ `MenuItem [1]` (role on MenuItem end: `item`)\n   - For **one ItemOrder**: refers to **exactly 1** MenuItem (`item`).\n   - For **one MenuItem**: appears in **0..*** ItemOrders.\n\n9. **MenuItemFoodItem**: `MenuItem [*]` ↔ `FoodItem [*]` (roles: MenuItem `isUtilized`, FoodItem `utilizes`)\n   - For **one MenuItem**: uses **0..*** FoodItems.\n   - For **one FoodItem**: used by **0..*** MenuItems.\n\n10. **FoodItemAllergen**: `FoodItem [*]` ↔ `Allergen [*]` (role on Allergen end: `contains`)\n   - For **one FoodItem**: `contains` **0..*** Allergens.\n   - For **one Allergen**: can be contained in **0..*** FoodItems.\n\n11. **MenuItemChef**: `MenuItem [*]` ↔ `Chef [1]` (roles: MenuItem `designs`, Chef `designedBy`)\n   - For **one MenuItem**: `designedBy` **exactly 1** Chef.\n   - For **one Chef**: `designs` **0..*** MenuItems.\n\n12. **ChefCook**: `Chef [1]` ↔ `Cook [1..*]` (roles: Chef `underSupervisionOf`, Cook `supervises`)\n   - For **one Chef**: `underSupervisionOf` **exactly 1** Cook.\n   - For **one Cook**: `supervises` **1..*** Chefs.\n\n13. **HeadWaiterWaiter**: `HeadWaiter [1]` ↔ `Waiter [1..*]` (role on Waiter end: `responsibleFor`)\n   - For **one Waiter**: has **exactly 1** HeadWaiter.\n   - For **one HeadWaiter**: `responsibleFor` **1..*** Waiters.\n\n---\n\n## Invariants\n1. **Table capacity must be positive**\n   - Context: `Table`\n   - `self.capacity > 0`\n\n2. **Cook experience must be non-negative**\n   - Context: `Cook`\n   - `self.yearsOfExperience >= 0`\n\n3. **Restaurant owner shares must sum to 100**\n   - Context: `Restaurant`\n   - Sum of `percentageShares` across all associated owners equals 100:\n   -
